How to read this book

Every śloka — the nyāsa, the four dhyāna ślokas and the 183 ślokas of the names — is set out the same way, top to bottom:

  1. The Sanskrit, large, exactly as it is recited, with a space wherever one word or name ends and the next begins without any letter changing. When sandhi joins two names, the joining sound stays with the first (भद्रमूर्तिर् भक्तसौभाग्यदायिनी), and an elided initial vowel is shown by the avagraha (सर्वारुणा ऽनवद्याङ्गी). Four times in the hymn two names melt into one sound and cannot be parted without changing the text (साध्वी = 711 sādhu + 712 ī, for example); there they stay together.
  2. The IAST transliteration, word for word the same.
  3. The names, separated — the learning view. Every name is shown on its own, numbered, in its own form, with light hyphens at the joints of a compound. A name marked ° has a different form in the recitation because of sandhi (भद्रमूर्तिः on its own, भद्रमूर्तिर् before भक्त…). This view is for learning; the line above is the text.
  4. The translation, name by name, numbered.
  5. Word by word: every name broken into its grammatical parts, each with its English meaning. The parts are given in their underlying forms (चित् + अग्नि for चिदग्नि), so the table shows what the words are, not only how they sound.
  6. The names: for each name its meaning, the sandhi inside it, its compound and the traditional analysing sentence (vigraha-vākya), and a short note on its significance. Readings that are disputed are marked Uncertain (129 of them, listed in Appendix B).

The text. The Lalitā Sahasranāma of the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa (Hayagrīva and Agastya), divided into 1,000 names as Bhāskararāya divides them: tat · tvam · ayī (425–427), sādhu · ī (711–712), brahma · jananī (822–823) and dharā · dharasutā (955–956) are his divisions. The text was corrected name by name, checked against an independent copy of the same recension, and proved against the metre (every half-śloka has its sixteen syllables). The names fill 182½ ślokas; the second half of śloka 183 closes the hymn. The nyāsa, dhyāna and colophon are not counted among the names. Every correction is in Appendix A.

Nyāsa न्यासः

Recited before the hymn: its seers, metre, deity, seed, power, linchpin and purpose.

Nyāsa

अस्य श्रीललितासहस्रनामस्तोत्रमालामन्त्रस्य ।
वशिन्यादिवाग्देवता ऋषयः ।
अनुष्टुप् छन्दः ।
श्रीललितापरमेश्वरी देवता ।
श्रीमद्वाग्भवकूटेति बीजम् ।
मध्यकूटेति शक्तिः ।
शक्तिकूटेति कीलकम् ।
श्रीललितामहात्रिपुरसुन्दरीप्रसादसिद्धिद्वारा चिन्तितफलावाप्त्यर्थे जपे विनियोगः ॥

asya śrīlalitāsahasranāmastotramālāmantrasya |
vaśinyādivāgdevatā ṛṣayaḥ |
anuṣṭup chandaḥ |
śrīlalitāparameśvarī devatā |
śrīmadvāgbhavakūṭeti bījam |
madhyakūṭeti śaktiḥ |
śaktikūṭeti kīlakam |
śrīlalitāmahātripurasundarīprasādasiddhidvārā cintitaphalāvāptyarthe jape viniyogaḥ ||

anuṣṭup chandaḥ
śrī-lalitā-parameśvarī devatā
śrīmad-vāgbhava-kūṭeti bījam
madhya-kūṭeti śaktiḥ
śakti-kūṭeti kīlakam

Translation

Of this garland-mantra, the hymn of the thousand names of Śrī Lalitā — the seers are the goddesses of speech, Vaśinī and the others; the metre is anuṣṭubh; the deity is Śrī Lalitā, the supreme Goddess; the bīja (seed) is the auspicious Vāgbhava-kūṭa; the śakti (power) is the middle kūṭa; the kīlaka (linchpin) is the Śakti-kūṭa; its use is in japa, to obtain the fruit one has in mind through gaining the grace of Śrī Lalitā Mahātripurasundarī.

Dhyāna ślokas ध्यानम्

Verses of meditation on the form of the Goddess, recited before the names.

Dhyāna 1metre: śārdūlavikrīḍita

सिन्दूरारुणविग्रहां त्रिनयनां माणिक्यमौलिस्फुरत्-
तारानायकशेखरां स्मितमुखीम् आपीनवक्षोरुहाम् ।
पाणिभ्याम् अलिपूर्णरत्नचषकं रक्तोत्पलं बिभ्रतीं
सौम्यां रत्नघटस्थरक्तचरणां ध्यायेत् पराम् अम्बिकाम् ॥

Translation

One should meditate on the supreme Mother: her body red as vermilion, three-eyed, her crest the moon (lord of the stars) shining on a crown of rubies; smiling, full-bosomed; holding in her hands a jewelled cup brimming with mead and a red lotus; gentle, her red feet resting on a jewelled jar.

अरुणां करुणातरङ्गिताक्षीं धृतपाशाङ्कुशपुष्पबाणचापाम् ।

Translation

I contemplate Bhavānī as none other than my own self: dawn-red, her eyes rippling with compassion, holding the noose, the goad, the flower-arrows and the bow, surrounded by Aṇimā and the other powers as by rays of light.

Translation

One should meditate on Bhavānī: seated on a lotus, her face beaming, her eyes long as lotus petals, golden in lustre, clad in yellow, a shining golden lotus in her hand, lovely of limb, adorned with every ornament, ever granting freedom from fear, inclined in kindness to her devotees — Śrīvidyā herself, peace embodied, praised by all the gods, the giver of every prosperity.

Dhyāna 4metre: pṛthvī

सकुङ्कुमविलेपनाम् अलिकचुम्बिकस्तूरिकां
समन्दहसितेक्षणां सशरचापपाशाङ्कुशाम् ।
अशेषजनमोहिनीम् अरुणमाल्यभूषाम्बरां
जपाकुसुमभासुरां जपविधौ स्मरेद् अम्बिकाम् ॥

sakuṅkumavilepanām alikacumbikastūrikāṃ
samandahasitekṣaṇāṃ saśaracāpapāśāṅkuśām |
aśeṣajanamohinīm aruṇamālyabhūṣāmbarāṃ
japākusumabhāsurāṃ japavidhau smared ambikām ||

Words separated, compounds hyphenated

स-कुङ्कुम-विलेपनाम् अलिक-चुम्बि-कस्तूरिकां
स-मन्द-हसितेक्षणां स-शर-चाप-पाशाङ्कुशाम्
अशेष-जन-मोहिनीम् अरुण-माल्य-भूषाम्बरां
जपा-कुसुम-भासुरां जप-विधौ स्मरेद् अम्बिकाम्sa-kuṅkuma-vilepanām alika-cumbi-kastūrikāṃ
sa-manda-hasitekṣaṇāṃ sa-śara-cāpa-pāśāṅkuśām
aśeṣa-jana-mohinīm aruṇa-mālya-bhūṣāmbarāṃ
japā-kusuma-bhāsurāṃ japa-vidhau smared ambikām

Translation

In the rite of japa one should call to mind the Mother: anointed with kuṅkuma, a mark of musk touching her forehead, her eyes soft with a gentle smile, holding arrows, bow, noose and goad, enchanting all beings, wearing red garlands, ornaments and garments, radiant as the hibiscus flower.

Śrī Lalitā Sahasranāma Stotram अथ श्रीललितासहस्रनामस्तोत्रम्

The text for recitation, words spaced as in the book. The number in the margin is the śloka; it links to the śloka's explanation.

1

श्रीमाता श्रीमहाराज्ञी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी ।
चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता देवकार्यसमुद्यता ॥ १ ॥

śrīmātā śrīmahārājñī śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī
cidagnikuṇḍasambhūtā devakāryasamudyatā

2

उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता ।
रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला ॥ २ ॥

udyadbhānusahasrābhā caturbāhusamanvitā
rāgasvarūpapāśāḍhyā krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

3

मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा पञ्चतन्मात्रसायका ।
निजारुणप्रभापूरमज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ ३ ॥

manorūpekṣukodaṇḍā pañcatanmātrasāyakā
nijāruṇaprabhāpūramajjadbrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā

4

चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसौगन्धिकलसत्कचा ।
कुरुविन्दमणिश्रेणीकनत्कोटीरमण्डिता ॥ ४ ॥

campakāśokapunnāgasaugandhikalasatkacā
kuruvindamaṇiśreṇīkanatkoṭīramaṇḍitā

5

अष्टमीचन्द्रविभ्राजदलिकस्थलशोभिता ।
मुखचन्द्रकलङ्काभमृगनाभिविशेषका ॥ ५ ॥

aṣṭamīcandravibhrājadalikasthalaśobhitā
mukhacandrakalaṅkābhamṛganābhiviśeṣakā

6

वदनस्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहतोरणचिल्लिका ।
वक्त्रलक्ष्मीपरीवाहचलन्मीनाभलोचना ॥ ६ ॥

vadanasmaramāṅgalyagṛhatoraṇacillikā
vaktralakṣmīparīvāhacalanmīnābhalocanā

7

नवचम्पकपुष्पाभनासादण्डविराजिता ।
ताराकान्तितिरस्कारिनासाभरणभासुरा ॥ ७ ॥

navacampakapuṣpābhanāsādaṇḍavirājitā
tārākāntitiraskārināsābharaṇabhāsurā

8

कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तकर्णपूरमनोहरा ।
ताटङ्कयुगलीभूततपनोडुपमण्डला ॥ ८ ॥

kadambamañjarīkḷptakarṇapūramanoharā
tāṭaṅkayugalībhūtatapanoḍupamaṇḍalā

9

पद्मरागशिलादर्शपरिभाविकपोलभूः ।
नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारिरदनच्छदा ॥ ९ ॥

padmarāgaśilādarśaparibhāvikapolabhūḥ
navavidrumabimbaśrīnyakkāriradanacchadā

10

शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकारद्विजपङ्क्तिद्वयोज्ज्वला ।
कर्पूरवीटिकामोदसमाकर्षिदिगन्तरा ॥ १० ॥

śuddhavidyāṅkurākāradvijapaṅktidvayojjvalā

11

निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सितकच्छपी ।
मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत्कामेशमानसा ॥ ११ ॥

अनाकलितसादृश्यचिबुकश्रीविराजिता ।
कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रशोभितकन्धरा ॥ १२ ॥

कनकाङ्गदकेयूरकमनीयभुजान्विता ।

kanakāṅgadakeyūrakamanīyabhujānvitā

14

कामेश्वरप्रेमरत्नमणिप्रतिपणस्तनी ।

15

लक्ष्यरोमलताधारतासमुन्नेयमध्यमा ।

अरुणारुणकौसुम्भवस्त्रभास्वत्कटीतटी ।

कामेशज्ञातसौभाग्यमार्दवोरुद्वयान्विता ।

kāmeśajñātasaubhāgyamārdavorudvayānvitā

18

इन्द्रगोपपरिक्षिप्तस्मरतूणाभजङ्घिका ।
गूढगुल्फा कूर्मपृष्ठजयिष्णुप्रपदान्विता ॥ १८ ॥

indragopaparikṣiptasmaratūṇābhajaṅghikā
gūḍhagulphā kūrmapṛṣṭhajayiṣṇuprapadānvitā

नखदीधितिसञ्छन्ननमज्जनतमोगुणा ।
पदद्वयप्रभाजालपराकृतसरोरुहा ॥ १९ ॥

nakhadīdhitisañchannanamajjanatamoguṇā

20

शिञ्जानमणिमञ्जीरमण्डितश्रीपदाम्बुजा ।
मरालीमन्दगमना महालावण्यशेवधिः ॥ २० ॥

śiñjānamaṇimañjīramaṇḍitaśrīpadāmbujā

21

सर्वारुणा ऽनवद्याङ्गी सर्वाभरणभूषिता ।
शिवकामेश्वराङ्कस्था शिवा स्वाधीनवल्लभा ॥ २१ ॥

sarvāruṇā 'navadyāṅgī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā

22

सुमेरुमध्यशृङ्गस्था श्रीमन्नगरनायिका ।

sumerumadhyaśṛṅgasthā śrīmannagaranāyikā
cintāmaṇigṛhāntasthā pañcabrahmāsanasthitā

23

महापद्माटवीसंस्था कदम्बवनवासिनी ।
सुधासागरमध्यस्था कामाक्षी कामदायिनी ॥ २३ ॥

mahāpadmāṭavīsaṃsthā kadambavanavāsinī
sudhāsāgaramadhyasthā kāmākṣī kāmadāyinī

24

देवर्षिगणसङ्घातस्तूयमानात्मवैभवा ।
भण्डासुरवधोद्युक्तशक्तिसेनासमन्विता ॥ २४ ॥

devarṣigaṇasaṅghātastūyamānātmavaibhavā
bhaṇḍāsuravadhodyuktaśaktisenāsamanvitā

25

सम्पत्करीसमारूढसिन्धुरव्रजसेविता ।
अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताश्वकोटिकोटिभिरावृता ॥ २५ ॥

sampatkarīsamārūḍhasindhuravrajasevitā
aśvārūḍhādhiṣṭhitāśvakoṭikoṭibhirāvṛtā

26

चक्रराजरथारूढसर्वायुधपरिष्कृता ।
गेयचक्ररथारूढमन्त्रिणीपरिसेविता ॥ २६ ॥

cakrarājarathārūḍhasarvāyudhapariṣkṛtā
geyacakrarathārūḍhamantriṇīparisevitā

27

किरिचक्ररथारूढदण्डनाथापुरस्कृता ।
ज्वालामालिनिकाक्षिप्तवह्निप्राकारमध्यगा ॥ २७ ॥

kiricakrarathārūḍhadaṇḍanāthāpuraskṛtā

28

भण्डसैन्यवधोद्युक्तशक्तिविक्रमहर्षिता ।
नित्यापराक्रमाटोपनिरीक्षणसमुत्सुका ॥ २८ ॥

bhaṇḍasainyavadhodyuktaśaktivikramaharṣitā

29

भण्डपुत्रवधोद्युक्तबालाविक्रमनन्दिता ।
मन्त्रिण्यम्बाविरचितविषङ्गवधतोषिता ॥ २९ ॥

bhaṇḍaputravadhodyuktabālāvikramananditā
mantriṇyambāviracitaviṣaṅgavadhatoṣitā

30

विशुक्रप्राणहरणवाराहीवीर्यनन्दिता ।
कामेश्वरमुखालोककल्पितश्रीगणेश्वरा ॥ ३० ॥

viśukraprāṇaharaṇavārāhīvīryananditā
kāmeśvaramukhālokakalpitaśrīgaṇeśvarā

31

महागणेशनिर्भिन्नविघ्नयन्त्रप्रहर्षिता ।
भण्डासुरेन्द्रनिर्मुक्तशस्त्रप्रत्यस्त्रवर्षिणी ॥ ३१ ॥

mahāgaṇeśanirbhinnavighnayantrapraharṣitā
bhaṇḍāsurendranirmuktaśastrapratyastravarṣiṇī

32

कराङ्गुलिनखोत्पन्ननारायणदशाकृतिः ।
महापाशुपतास्त्राग्निनिर्दग्धासुरसैनिका ॥ ३२ ॥

karāṅgulinakhotpannanārāyaṇadaśākṛtiḥ
mahāpāśupatāstrāgninirdagdhāsurasainikā

33

कामेश्वरास्त्रनिर्दग्धसभण्डासुरशून्यका ।
ब्रह्मोपेन्द्रमहेन्द्रादिदेवसंस्तुतवैभवा ॥ ३३ ॥

kāmeśvarāstranirdagdhasabhaṇḍāsuraśūnyakā
brahmopendramahendrādidevasaṃstutavaibhavā

34

हरनेत्राग्निसन्दग्धकामसञ्जीवनौषधिः ।

haranetrāgnisandagdhakāmasañjīvanauṣadhiḥ
śrīmadvāgbhavakūṭaikasvarūpamukhapaṅkajā

35

कण्ठाधःकटिपर्यन्तमध्यकूटस्वरूपिणी ।
शक्तिकूटैकतापन्नकट्यधोभागधारिणी ॥ ३५ ॥

kaṇṭhādhaḥkaṭiparyantamadhyakūṭasvarūpiṇī
śaktikūṭaikatāpannakaṭyadhobhāgadhāriṇī

36

मूलमन्त्रात्मिका मूलकूटत्रयकलेवरा ।
कुलामृतैकरसिका कुलसङ्केतपालिनी ॥ ३६ ॥

mūlamantrātmikā mūlakūṭatrayakalevarā
kulāmṛtaikarasikā kulasaṅketapālinī

37

कुलाङ्गना कुलान्तस्था कौलिनी कुलयोगिनी ।
अकुला समयान्तस्था समयाचारतत्परा ॥ ३७ ॥

kulāṅganā kulāntasthā kaulinī kulayoginī
akulā samayāntasthā samayācāratatparā

38

मूलाधारैकनिलया ब्रह्मग्रन्थिविभेदिनी ।
मणिपूरान्तरुदिता विष्णुग्रन्थिविभेदिनी ॥ ३८ ॥

mūlādhāraikanilayā brahmagranthivibhedinī
maṇipūrāntaruditā viṣṇugranthivibhedinī

39

आज्ञाचक्रान्तरालस्था रुद्रग्रन्थिविभेदिनी ।
सहस्राराम्बुजारूढा सुधासाराभिवर्षिणी ॥ ३९ ॥

ājñācakrāntarālasthā rudragranthivibhedinī
sahasrārāmbujārūḍhā sudhāsārābhivarṣiṇī

40

तडिल्लतासमरुचिः षट्चक्रोपरिसंस्थिता ।
महासक्तिः कुण्डलिनी बिसतन्तुतनीयसी ॥ ४० ॥

taḍillatāsamaruciḥ ṣaṭcakroparisaṃsthitā
mahāsaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī bisatantutanīyasī

41

भवानी भावनागम्या भवारण्यकुठारिका ।
भद्रप्रिया भद्रमूर्तिर् भक्तसौभाग्यदायिनी ॥ ४१ ॥

bhavānī bhāvanāgamyā bhavāraṇyakuṭhārikā
bhadrapriyā bhadramūrtir bhaktasaubhāgyadāyinī

42

भक्तिप्रिया भक्तिगम्या भक्तिवश्या भयापहा ।
शाम्भवी शारदाराध्या शर्वाणी शर्मदायिनी ॥ ४२ ॥

bhaktipriyā bhaktigamyā bhaktivaśyā bhayāpahā
śāmbhavī śāradārādhyā śarvāṇī śarmadāyinī

43

शाङ्करी श्रीकरी साध्वी शरच्चन्द्रनिभानना ।
शातोदरी शान्तिमती निराधारा निरञ्जना ॥ ४३ ॥

śāṅkarī śrīkarī sādhvī śaraccandranibhānanā
śātodarī śāntimatī nirādhārā nirañjanā

44

निर्लेपा निर्मला नित्या निराकारा निराकुला ।
निर्गुणा निष्कला शान्ता निष्कामा निरुपप्लवा ॥ ४४ ॥

nirlepā nirmalā nityā nirākārā nirākulā
nirguṇā niṣkalā śāntā niṣkāmā nirupaplavā

45

नित्यमुक्ता निर्विकारा निष्प्रपञ्चा निराश्रया ।
नित्यशुद्धा नित्यबुद्धा निरवद्या निरन्तरा ॥ ४५ ॥

nityamuktā nirvikārā niṣprapañcā nirāśrayā
nityaśuddhā nityabuddhā niravadyā nirantarā

46

निष्कारणा निष्कलङ्का निरुपाधिर् निरीश्वरा ।
नीरागा रागमथनी निर्मदा मदनाशिनी ॥ ४६ ॥

niṣkāraṇā niṣkalaṅkā nirupādhir nirīśvarā
nīrāgā rāgamathanī nirmadā madanāśinī

47

निश्चिन्ता निरहङ्कारा निर्मोहा मोहनाशिनी ।
निर्ममा ममताहन्त्री निष्पापा पापनाशिनी ॥ ४७ ॥

niścintā nirahaṅkārā nirmohā mohanāśinī
nirmamā mamatāhantrī niṣpāpā pāpanāśinī

48

निष्क्रोधा क्रोधशमनी निर्लोभा लोभनाशिनी ।
निःसंशया संशयघ्नी निर्भवा भवनाशिनी ॥ ४८ ॥

niṣkrodhā krodhaśamanī nirlobhā lobhanāśinī
niḥsaṃśayā saṃśayaghnī nirbhavā bhavanāśinī

49

निर्विकल्पा निराबाधा निर्भेदा भेदनाशिनी ।
निर्नाशा मृत्युमथनी निष्क्रिया निष्परिग्रहा ॥ ४९ ॥

nirvikalpā nirābādhā nirbhedā bhedanāśinī
nirnāśā mṛtyumathanī niṣkriyā niṣparigrahā

50

निस्तुला नीलचिकुरा निरपाया निरत्यया ।
दुर्लभा दुर्गमा दुर्गा दुःखहन्त्री सुखप्रदा ॥ ५० ॥

nistulā nīlacikurā nirapāyā niratyayā
durlabhā durgamā durgā duḥkhahantrī sukhapradā

51

दुष्टदूरा दुराचारशमनी दोषवर्जिता ।
सर्वज्ञा सान्द्रकरुणा समानाधिकवर्जिता ॥ ५१ ॥

duṣṭadūrā durācāraśamanī doṣavarjitā
sarvajñā sāndrakaruṇā samānādhikavarjitā

52

सर्वशक्तिमयी सर्वमङ्गला सद्गतिप्रदा ।
सर्वेश्वरी सर्वमयी सर्वमन्त्रस्वरूपिणी ॥ ५२ ॥

sarvaśaktimayī sarvamaṅgalā sadgatipradā
sarveśvarī sarvamayī sarvamantrasvarūpiṇī

53

सर्वयन्त्रात्मिका सर्वतन्त्ररूपा मनोन्मनी ।
माहेश्वरी महादेवी महालक्ष्मीर् मृडप्रिया ॥ ५३ ॥

sarvayantrātmikā sarvatantrarūpā manonmanī
māheśvarī mahādevī mahālakṣmīr mṛḍapriyā

54

महारूपा महापूज्या महापातकनाशिनी ।
महामाया महासत्त्वा महाशक्तिर् महारतिः ॥ ५४ ॥

mahārūpā mahāpūjyā mahāpātakanāśinī
mahāmāyā mahāsattvā mahāśaktir mahāratiḥ

55

महाभोगा महैश्वर्या महावीर्या महाबला ।
महाबुद्धिर् महासिद्धिर् महायोगेश्वरेश्वरी ॥ ५५ ॥

mahābhogā mahaiśvaryā mahāvīryā mahābalā
mahābuddhir mahāsiddhir mahāyogeśvareśvarī

56

महातन्त्रा महामन्त्रा महायन्त्रा महासना ।
महायागक्रमाराध्या महाभैरवपूजिता ॥ ५६ ॥

mahātantrā mahāmantrā mahāyantrā mahāsanā
mahāyāgakramārādhyā mahābhairavapūjitā

57

महेश्वरमहाकल्पमहाताण्डवसाक्षिणी ।
महाकामेशमहिषी महात्रिपुरसुन्दरी ॥ ५७ ॥

maheśvaramahākalpamahātāṇḍavasākṣiṇī
mahākāmeśamahiṣī mahātripurasundarī

58

चतुःषष्ट्युपचाराढ्या चतुःषष्टिकलामयी ।
महाचतुःषष्टिकोटियोगिनीगणसेविता ॥ ५८ ॥

catuḥṣaṣṭyupacārāḍhyā catuḥṣaṣṭikalāmayī
mahācatuḥṣaṣṭikoṭiyoginīgaṇasevitā

59

मनुविद्या चन्द्रविद्या चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगा ।
चारुरूपा चारुहासा चारुचन्द्रकलाधरा ॥ ५९ ॥

manuvidyā candravidyā candramaṇḍalamadhyagā
cārurūpā cāruhāsā cārucandrakalādharā

60

चराचरजगन्नाथा चक्रराजनिकेतना ।
पार्वती पद्मनयना पद्मरागसमप्रभा ॥ ६० ॥

carācarajagannāthā cakrarājaniketanā
pārvatī padmanayanā padmarāgasamaprabhā

61

पञ्चप्रेतासनासीना पञ्चब्रह्मस्वरूपिणी ।
चिन्मयी परमानन्दा विज्ञानघनरूपिणी ॥ ६१ ॥

pañcapretāsanāsīnā pañcabrahmasvarūpiṇī
cinmayī paramānandā vijñānaghanarūpiṇī

62

ध्यानध्यातृध्येयरूपा धर्माधर्मविवर्जिता ।
विश्वरूपा जागरिणी स्वपन्ती तैजसात्मिका ॥ ६२ ॥

dhyānadhyātṛdhyeyarūpā dharmādharmavivarjitā
viśvarūpā jāgariṇī svapantī taijasātmikā

63

सुप्ता प्राज्ञात्मिका तुर्या सर्वावस्थाविवर्जिता ।
सृष्टिकर्त्री ब्रह्मरूपा गोप्त्री गोविन्दरूपिणी ॥ ६३ ॥

suptā prājñātmikā turyā sarvāvasthāvivarjitā
sṛṣṭikartrī brahmarūpā goptrī govindarūpiṇī

64

संहारिणी रुद्ररूपा तिरोधानकरीश्वरी ।
सदाशिवा ऽनुग्रहदा पञ्चकृत्यपरायणा ॥ ६४ ॥

saṃhāriṇī rudrarūpā tirodhānakarīśvarī
sadāśivā 'nugrahadā pañcakṛtyaparāyaṇā

65

भानुमण्डलमध्यस्था भैरवी भगमालिनी ।
पद्मासना भगवती पद्मनाभसहोदरी ॥ ६५ ॥

bhānumaṇḍalamadhyasthā bhairavī bhagamālinī
padmāsanā bhagavatī padmanābhasahodarī

66

उन्मेषनिमिषोत्पन्नविपन्नभुवनावली ।
सहस्रशीर्षवदना सहस्राक्षी सहस्रपात् ॥ ६६ ॥

unmeṣanimiṣotpannavipannabhuvanāvalī
sahasraśīrṣavadanā sahasrākṣī sahasrapāt

67

आब्रह्मकीटजननी वर्णाश्रमविधायिनी ।
निजाज्ञारूपनिगमा पुण्यापुण्यफलप्रदा ॥ ६७ ॥

ābrahmakīṭajananī varṇāśramavidhāyinī
nijājñārūpanigamā puṇyāpuṇyaphalapradā

68

श्रुतिसीमन्तसिन्दूरीकृतपादाब्जधूलिका ।
सकलागमसन्दोहशुक्तिसम्पुटमौक्तिका ॥ ६८ ॥

śrutisīmantasindūrīkṛtapādābjadhūlikā
sakalāgamasandohaśuktisampuṭamauktikā

69

पुरुषार्थप्रदा पूर्णा भोगिनी भुवनेश्वरी ।
अम्बिका ऽनादिनिधना हरिब्रह्मेन्द्रसेविता ॥ ६९ ॥

puruṣārthapradā pūrṇā bhoginī bhuvaneśvarī
ambikā 'nādinidhanā haribrahmendrasevitā

70

नारायणी नादरूपा नामरूपविवर्जिता ।
ह्रीङ्कारी ह्रीमती हृद्या हेयोपादेयवर्जिता ॥ ७० ॥

nārāyaṇī nādarūpā nāmarūpavivarjitā
hrīṅkārī hrīmatī hṛdyā heyopādeyavarjitā

71

राजराजार्चिता राज्ञी रम्या राजीवलोचना ।
रञ्जनी रमणी रस्या रणत्किङ्किणिमेखला ॥ ७१ ॥

rājarājārcitā rājñī ramyā rājīvalocanā
rañjanī ramaṇī rasyā raṇatkiṅkiṇimekhalā

72

रमा राकेन्दुवदना रतिरूपा रतिप्रिया ।
रक्षाकरी राक्षसघ्नी रामा रमणलम्पटा ॥ ७२ ॥

ramā rākenduvadanā ratirūpā ratipriyā
rakṣākarī rākṣasaghnī rāmā ramaṇalampaṭā

73

काम्या कामकलारूपा कदम्बकुसुमप्रिया ।
कल्याणी जगतीकन्दा करुणारससागरा ॥ ७३ ॥

kāmyā kāmakalārūpā kadambakusumapriyā
kalyāṇī jagatīkandā karuṇārasasāgarā

74

कलावती कलालापा कान्ता कादम्बरीप्रिया ।
वरदा वामनयना वारुणीमदविह्वला ॥ ७४ ॥

kalāvatī kalālāpā kāntā kādambarīpriyā
varadā vāmanayanā vāruṇīmadavihvalā

75

विश्वाधिका वेदवेद्या विन्ध्याचलनिवासिनी ।
विधात्री वेदजननी विष्णुमाया विलासिनी ॥ ७५ ॥

viśvādhikā vedavedyā vindhyācalanivāsinī
vidhātrī vedajananī viṣṇumāyā vilāsinī

76

क्षेत्रस्वरूपा क्षेत्रेशी क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञपालिनी ।
क्षयवृद्धिविनिर्मुक्ता क्षेत्रपालसमर्चिता ॥ ७६ ॥

kṣetrasvarūpā kṣetreśī kṣetrakṣetrajñapālinī
kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktā kṣetrapālasamarcitā

77

विजया विमला वन्द्या वन्दारुजनवत्सला ।
वाग्वादिनी वामकेशी वह्निमण्डलवासिनी ॥ ७७ ॥

vijayā vimalā vandyā vandārujanavatsalā
vāgvādinī vāmakeśī vahnimaṇḍalavāsinī

78

भक्तिमत्कल्पलतिका पशुपाशविमोचिनी ।
संहृताशेषपाषण्डा सदाचारप्रवर्तिका ॥ ७८ ॥

bhaktimatkalpalatikā paśupāśavimocinī
saṃhṛtāśeṣapāṣaṇḍā sadācārapravartikā

79

तापत्रयाग्निसन्तप्तसमाह्लादनचन्द्रिका ।
तरुणी तापसाराध्या तनुमध्या तमोऽपहा ॥ ७९ ॥

tāpatrayāgnisantaptasamāhlādanacandrikā
taruṇī tāpasārādhyā tanumadhyā tamo'pahā

80

चितिस् तत्पदलक्ष्यार्था चिदेकरसरूपिणी ।
स्वात्मानन्दलवीभूतब्रह्माद्यानन्दसन्ततिः ॥ ८० ॥

citis tatpadalakṣyārthā cidekarasarūpiṇī
svātmānandalavībhūtabrahmādyānandasantatiḥ

81

परा प्रत्यक्चितीरूपा पश्यन्ती परदेवता ।
मध्यमा वैखरीरूपा भक्तमानसहंसिका ॥ ८१ ॥

parā pratyakcitīrūpā paśyantī paradevatā
madhyamā vaikharīrūpā bhaktamānasahaṃsikā

82

कामेश्वरप्राणनाडी कृतज्ञा कामपूजिता ।
शृङ्गाररससम्पूर्णा जया जालन्धरस्थिता ॥ ८२ ॥

kāmeśvaraprāṇanāḍī kṛtajñā kāmapūjitā
śṛṅgārarasasampūrṇā jayā jālandharasthitā

83

ओड्याणपीठनिलया बिन्दुमण्डलवासिनी ।
रहोयागक्रमाराध्या रहस्तर्पणतर्पिता ॥ ८३ ॥

oḍyāṇapīṭhanilayā bindumaṇḍalavāsinī
rahoyāgakramārādhyā rahastarpaṇatarpitā

84

सद्यःप्रसादिनी विश्वसाक्षिणी साक्षिवर्जिता ।
षडङ्गदेवतायुक्ता षाड्गुण्यपरिपूरिता ॥ ८४ ॥

sadyaḥprasādinī viśvasākṣiṇī sākṣivarjitā
ṣaḍaṅgadevatāyuktā ṣāḍguṇyaparipūritā

85

नित्यक्लिन्ना निरुपमा निर्वाणसुखदायिनी ।
नित्याषोडशिकारूपा श्रीकण्ठार्धशरीरिणी ॥ ८५ ॥

nityaklinnā nirupamā nirvāṇasukhadāyinī
nityāṣoḍaśikārūpā śrīkaṇṭhārdhaśarīriṇī

86

प्रभावती प्रभारूपा प्रसिद्धा परमेश्वरी ।
मूलप्रकृतिर् अव्यक्ता व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपिणी ॥ ८६ ॥

prabhāvatī prabhārūpā prasiddhā parameśvarī
mūlaprakṛtir avyaktā vyaktāvyaktasvarūpiṇī

87

व्यापिनी विविधाकारा विद्याऽविद्यास्वरूपिणी ।
महाकामेशनयनकुमुदाह्लादकौमुदी ॥ ८७ ॥

vyāpinī vividhākārā vidyā'vidyāsvarūpiṇī
mahākāmeśanayanakumudāhlādakaumudī

88

भक्तहार्दतमोभेदभानुमद्भानुसन्ततिः ।
शिवदूती शिवाराध्या शिवमूर्तिः शिवङ्करी ॥ ८८ ॥

bhaktahārdatamobhedabhānumadbhānusantatiḥ
śivadūtī śivārādhyā śivamūrtiḥ śivaṅkarī

89

शिवप्रिया शिवपरा शिष्टेष्टा शिष्टपूजिता ।
अप्रमेया स्वप्रकाशा मनोवाचामगोचरा ॥ ८९ ॥

śivapriyā śivaparā śiṣṭeṣṭā śiṣṭapūjitā
aprameyā svaprakāśā manovācāmagocarā

90

चिच्छक्तिश् चेतनारूपा जडशक्तिर् जडात्मिका ।
गायत्री व्याहृतिः सन्ध्या द्विजवृन्दनिषेविता ॥ ९० ॥

cicchaktiś cetanārūpā jaḍaśaktir jaḍātmikā
gāyatrī vyāhṛtiḥ sandhyā dvijavṛndaniṣevitā

91

तत्त्वासना तत् त्वम् अयी पञ्चकोशान्तरस्थिता ।
निःसीममहिमा नित्ययौवना मदशालिनी ॥ ९१ ॥

tattvāsanā tat tvam ayī pañcakośāntarasthitā
niḥsīmamahimā nityayauvanā madaśālinī

92

मदघूर्णितरक्ताक्षी मदपाटलगण्डभूः ।
चन्दनद्रवदिग्धाङ्गी चाम्पेयकुसुमप्रिया ॥ ९२ ॥

madaghūrṇitaraktākṣī madapāṭalagaṇḍabhūḥ
candanadravadigdhāṅgī cāmpeyakusumapriyā

93

कुशला कोमलाकारा कुरुकुल्ला कुलेश्वरी ।
कुलकुण्डालया कौलमार्गतत्परसेविता ॥ ९३ ॥

kuśalā komalākārā kurukullā kuleśvarī
kulakuṇḍālayā kaulamārgatatparasevitā

94

कुमारगणनाथाम्बा तुष्टिः पुष्टिर् मतिर् धृतिः ।
शान्तिः स्वस्तिमती कान्तिर् नन्दिनी विघ्ननाशिनी ॥ ९४ ॥

kumāragaṇanāthāmbā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭir matir dhṛtiḥ
śāntiḥ svastimatī kāntir nandinī vighnanāśinī

95

तेजोवती त्रिनयना लोलाक्षीकामरूपिणी ।
मालिनी हंसिनी माता मलयाचलवासिनी ॥ ९५ ॥

tejovatī trinayanā lolākṣīkāmarūpiṇī
mālinī haṃsinī mātā malayācalavāsinī

96

सुमुखी नलिनी सुभ्रूः शोभना सुरनायिका ।
कालकण्ठी कान्तिमती क्षोभिणी सूक्ष्मरूपिणी ॥ ९६ ॥

sumukhī nalinī subhrūḥ śobhanā suranāyikā
kālakaṇṭhī kāntimatī kṣobhiṇī sūkṣmarūpiṇī

97

वज्रेश्वरी वामदेवी वयोऽवस्थाविवर्जिता ।
सिद्धेश्वरी सिद्धविद्या सिद्धमाता यशस्विनी ॥ ९७ ॥

vajreśvarī vāmadevī vayo'vasthāvivarjitā
siddheśvarī siddhavidyā siddhamātā yaśasvinī

98

विशुद्धिचक्रनिलया ऽऽरक्तवर्णा त्रिलोचना ।
खट्वाङ्गादिप्रहरणा वदनैकसमन्विता ॥ ९८ ॥

viśuddhicakranilayā ''raktavarṇā trilocanā
khaṭvāṅgādipraharaṇā vadanaikasamanvitā

99

पायसान्नप्रिया त्वक्स्था पशुलोकभयङ्करी ।
अमृतादिमहाशक्तिसंवृता डाकिनीश्वरी ॥ ९९ ॥

pāyasānnapriyā tvaksthā paśulokabhayaṅkarī
amṛtādimahāśaktisaṃvṛtā ḍākinīśvarī

100

अनाहताब्जनिलया श्यामाभा वदनद्वया ।
दंष्ट्रोज्ज्वला ऽक्षमालादिधरा रुधिरसंस्थिता ॥ १०० ॥

anāhatābjanilayā śyāmābhā vadanadvayā
daṃṣṭrojjvalā 'kṣamālādidharā rudhirasaṃsthitā

101

कालरात्र्यादिशक्त्यौघवृता स्निग्धौदनप्रिया ।
महावीरेन्द्रवरदा राकिण्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ॥ १०१ ॥

kālarātryādiśaktyaughavṛtā snigdhaudanapriyā
mahāvīrendravaradā rākiṇyambāsvarūpiṇī

102

मणिपूराब्जनिलया वदनत्रयसंयुता ।
वज्रादिकायुधोपेता डामर्यादिभिरावृता ॥ १०२ ॥

maṇipūrābjanilayā vadanatrayasaṃyutā
vajrādikāyudhopetā ḍāmaryādibhirāvṛtā

103

रक्तवर्णा मांसनिष्ठा गुडान्नप्रीतमानसा ।
समस्तभक्तसुखदा लाकिन्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ॥ १०३ ॥

raktavarṇā māṃsaniṣṭhā guḍānnaprītamānasā
samastabhaktasukhadā lākinyambāsvarūpiṇī

104

स्वाधिष्ठानाम्बुजगता चतुर्वक्त्रमनोहरा ।
शूलाद्यायुधसम्पन्ना पीतवर्णा ऽतिगर्विता ॥ १०४ ॥

svādhiṣṭhānāmbujagatā caturvaktramanoharā
śūlādyāyudhasampannā pītavarṇā 'tigarvitā

105

मेदोनिष्ठा मधुप्रीता बन्धिन्यादिसमन्विता ।
दध्यन्नासक्तहृदया काकिनीरूपधारिणी ॥ १०५ ॥

medoniṣṭhā madhuprītā bandhinyādisamanvitā
dadhyannāsaktahṛdayā kākinīrūpadhāriṇī

106

मूलाधाराम्बुजारूढा पञ्चवक्त्रा ऽस्थिसंस्थिता ।
अङ्कुशादिप्रहरणा वरदादिनिषेविता ॥ १०६ ॥

mūlādhārāmbujārūḍhā pañcavaktrā 'sthisaṃsthitā
aṅkuśādipraharaṇā varadādiniṣevitā

107

मुद्गौदनासक्तचित्ता साकिन्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ।
आज्ञाचक्राब्जनिलया शुक्लवर्णा षडानना ॥ १०७ ॥

mudgaudanāsaktacittā sākinyambāsvarūpiṇī
ājñācakrābjanilayā śuklavarṇā ṣaḍānanā

108

मज्जासंस्था हंसवतीमुख्यशक्तिसमन्विता ।
हरिद्रान्नैकरसिका हाकिनीरूपधारिणी ॥ १०८ ॥

majjāsaṃsthā haṃsavatīmukhyaśaktisamanvitā
haridrānnaikarasikā hākinīrūpadhāriṇī

109

सहस्रदलपद्मस्था सर्ववर्णोपशोभिता ।
सर्वायुधधरा शुक्लसंस्थिता सर्वतोमुखी ॥ १०९ ॥

sahasradalapadmasthā sarvavarṇopaśobhitā
sarvāyudhadharā śuklasaṃsthitā sarvatomukhī

110

सर्वौदनप्रीतचित्ता याकिन्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ।
स्वाहा स्वधा ऽमतिर् मेधा श्रुतिः स्मृतिर् अनुत्तमा ॥ ११० ॥

sarvaudanaprītacittā yākinyambāsvarūpiṇī
svāhā svadhā 'matir medhā śrutiḥ smṛtir anuttamā

111

पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यलभ्या पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तना ।
पुलोमजार्चिता बन्धमोचनी बन्धुरालका ॥ १११ ॥

puṇyakīrtiḥ puṇyalabhyā puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanā
pulomajārcitā bandhamocanī bandhurālakā

112

विमर्शरूपिणी विद्या वियदादिजगत्प्रसूः ।
सर्वव्याधिप्रशमनी सर्वमृत्युनिवारिणी ॥ ११२ ॥

vimarśarūpiṇī vidyā viyadādijagatprasūḥ
sarvavyādhipraśamanī sarvamṛtyunivāriṇī

113

अग्रगण्या ऽचिन्त्यरूपा कलिकल्मषनाशिनी ।
कात्यायनी कालहन्त्री कमलाक्षनिषेविता ॥ ११३ ॥

agragaṇyā 'cintyarūpā kalikalmaṣanāśinī
kātyāyanī kālahantrī kamalākṣaniṣevitā

114

ताम्बूलपूरितमुखी दाडिमीकुसुमप्रभा ।
मृगाक्षी मोहिनी मुख्या मृडानी मित्ररूपिणी ॥ ११४ ॥

tāmbūlapūritamukhī dāḍimīkusumaprabhā
mṛgākṣī mohinī mukhyā mṛḍānī mitrarūpiṇī

115

नित्यतृप्ता भक्तनिधिर् नियन्त्री निखिलेश्वरी ।
मैत्र्यादिवासनालभ्या महाप्रलयसाक्षिणी ॥ ११५ ॥

nityatṛptā bhaktanidhir niyantrī nikhileśvarī
maitryādivāsanālabhyā mahāpralayasākṣiṇī

116

परा शक्तिः परा निष्ठा प्रज्ञानघनरूपिणी ।
माध्वीपानालसा मत्ता मातृकावर्णरूपिणी ॥ ११६ ॥

parā śaktiḥ parā niṣṭhā prajñānaghanarūpiṇī
mādhvīpānālasā mattā mātṛkāvarṇarūpiṇī

117

महाकैलासनिलया मृणालमृदुदोर्लता ।
महनीया दयामूर्तिर् महासाम्राज्यशालिनी ॥ ११७ ॥

mahākailāsanilayā mṛṇālamṛdudorlatā
mahanīyā dayāmūrtir mahāsāmrājyaśālinī

118

आत्मविद्या महाविद्या श्रीविद्या कामसेविता ।
श्रीषोडशाक्षरीविद्या त्रिकूटा कामकोटिका ॥ ११८ ॥

ātmavidyā mahāvidyā śrīvidyā kāmasevitā
śrīṣoḍaśākṣarīvidyā trikūṭā kāmakoṭikā

119

कटाक्षकिङ्करीभूतकमलाकोटिसेविता ।
शिरःस्थिता चन्द्रनिभा भालस्थेन्द्रधनुःप्रभा ॥ ११९ ॥

kaṭākṣakiṅkarībhūtakamalākoṭisevitā
śiraḥsthitā candranibhā bhālasthendradhanuḥprabhā

120

हृदयस्था रविप्रख्या त्रिकोणान्तरदीपिका ।
दाक्षायणी दैत्यहन्त्री दक्षयज्ञविनाशिनी ॥ १२० ॥

hṛdayasthā raviprakhyā trikoṇāntaradīpikā
dākṣāyaṇī daityahantrī dakṣayajñavināśinī

121

दरान्दोलितदीर्घाक्षी दरहासोज्ज्वलन्मुखी ।
गुरुमूर्तिर् गुणनिधिर् गोमाता गुहजन्मभूः ॥ १२१ ॥

darāndolitadīrghākṣī darahāsojjvalanmukhī
gurumūrtir guṇanidhir gomātā guhajanmabhūḥ

122

देवेशी दण्डनीतिस्था दहराकाशरूपिणी ।
प्रतिपन्मुख्यराकान्ततिथिमण्डलपूजिता ॥ १२२ ॥

deveśī daṇḍanītisthā daharākāśarūpiṇī
pratipanmukhyarākāntatithimaṇḍalapūjitā

123

कलात्मिका कलानाथा काव्यालापविनोदिनी ।
सचामररमावाणीसव्यदक्षिणसेविता ॥ १२३ ॥

kalātmikā kalānāthā kāvyālāpavinodinī
sacāmararamāvāṇīsavyadakṣiṇasevitā

124

आदिशक्तिर् अमेया ऽऽत्मा परमा पावनाकृतिः ।
अनेककोटिब्रह्माण्डजननी दिव्यविग्रहा ॥ १२४ ॥

ādiśaktir ameyā ''tmā paramā pāvanākṛtiḥ
anekakoṭibrahmāṇḍajananī divyavigrahā

125

क्लीङ्कारी केवला गुह्या कैवल्यपददायिनी ।
त्रिपुरा त्रिजगद्वन्द्या त्रिमूर्तिस् त्रिदशेश्वरी ॥ १२५ ॥

klīṅkārī kevalā guhyā kaivalyapadadāyinī
tripurā trijagadvandyā trimūrtis tridaśeśvarī

126

त्र्यक्षरी दिव्यगन्धाढ्या सिन्दूरतिलकाञ्चिता ।
उमा शैलेन्द्रतनया गौरी गन्धर्वसेविता ॥ १२६ ॥

tryakṣarī divyagandhāḍhyā sindūratilakāñcitā
umā śailendratanayā gaurī gandharvasevitā

127

विश्वगर्भा स्वर्णगर्भा ऽवरदा वागधीश्वरी ।
ध्यानगम्या ऽपरिच्छेद्या ज्ञानदा ज्ञानविग्रहा ॥ १२७ ॥

viśvagarbhā svarṇagarbhā 'varadā vāgadhīśvarī
dhyānagamyā 'paricchedyā jñānadā jñānavigrahā

128

सर्ववेदान्तसंवेद्या सत्यानन्दस्वरूपिणी ।
लोपामुद्रार्चिता लीलाकॢप्तब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ १२८ ॥

sarvavedāntasaṃvedyā satyānandasvarūpiṇī
lopāmudrārcitā līlākḷptabrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā

129

अदृश्या दृश्यरहिता विज्ञात्री वेद्यवर्जिता ।
योगिनी योगदा योग्या योगानन्दा युगन्धरा ॥ १२९ ॥

adṛśyā dṛśyarahitā vijñātrī vedyavarjitā
yoginī yogadā yogyā yogānandā yugandharā

130

इच्छाशक्तिज्ञानशक्तिक्रियाशक्तिस्वरूपिणी ।
सर्वाधारा सुप्रतिष्ठा सदसद्रूपधारिणी ॥ १३० ॥

icchāśaktijñānaśaktikriyāśaktisvarūpiṇī
sarvādhārā supratiṣṭhā sadasadrūpadhāriṇī

131

अष्टमूर्तिर् अजाजैत्री लोकयात्राविधायिनी ।
एकाकिनी भूमरूपा निर्द्वैता द्वैतवर्जिता ॥ १३१ ॥

aṣṭamūrtir ajājaitrī lokayātrāvidhāyinī
ekākinī bhūmarūpā nirdvaitā dvaitavarjitā

132

अन्नदा वसुदा वृद्धा ब्रह्मात्मैक्यस्वरूपिणी ।
बृहती ब्राह्मणी ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मानन्दा बलिप्रिया ॥ १३२ ॥

annadā vasudā vṛddhā brahmātmaikyasvarūpiṇī
bṛhatī brāhmaṇī brāhmī brahmānandā balipriyā

133

भाषारूपा बृहत्सेना भावाभावविवर्जिता ।
सुखाराध्या शुभकरी शोभना सुलभा गतिः ॥ १३३ ॥

bhāṣārūpā bṛhatsenā bhāvābhāvavivarjitā
sukhārādhyā śubhakarī śobhanā sulabhā gatiḥ

134

राजराजेश्वरी राज्यदायिनी राज्यवल्लभा ।
राजत्कृपा राजपीठनिवेशितनिजाश्रिता ॥ १३४ ॥

rājarājeśvarī rājyadāyinī rājyavallabhā
rājatkṛpā rājapīṭhaniveśitanijāśritā

135

राज्यलक्ष्मीः कोशनाथा चतुरङ्गबलेश्वरी ।
साम्राज्यदायिनी सत्यसन्धा सागरमेखला ॥ १३५ ॥

rājyalakṣmīḥ kośanāthā caturaṅgabaleśvarī
sāmrājyadāyinī satyasandhā sāgaramekhalā

136

दीक्षिता दैत्यशमनी सर्वलोकवशङ्करी ।
सर्वार्थदात्री सावित्री सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणी ॥ १३६ ॥

dīkṣitā daityaśamanī sarvalokavaśaṅkarī
sarvārthadātrī sāvitrī saccidānandarūpiṇī

137

देशकालापरिच्छिन्ना सर्वगा सर्वमोहिनी ।
सरस्वती शास्त्रमयी गुहाम्बा गुह्यरूपिणी ॥ १३७ ॥

deśakālāparicchinnā sarvagā sarvamohinī
sarasvatī śāstramayī guhāmbā guhyarūpiṇī

138

सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्ता सदाशिवपतिव्रता ।
सम्प्रदायेश्वरी साध्वी गुरुमण्डलरूपिणी ॥ १३८ ॥

sarvopādhivinirmuktā sadāśivapativratā
sampradāyeśvarī sādhvī gurumaṇḍalarūpiṇī

139

कुलोत्तीर्णा भगाराध्या माया मधुमती मही ।
गणाम्बा गुह्यकाराध्या कोमलाङ्गी गुरुप्रिया ॥ १३९ ॥

kulottīrṇā bhagārādhyā māyā madhumatī mahī
gaṇāmbā guhyakārādhyā komalāṅgī gurupriyā

140

स्वतन्त्रा सर्वतन्त्रेशी दक्षिणामूर्तिरूपिणी ।
सनकादिसमाराध्या शिवज्ञानप्रदायिनी ॥ १४० ॥

svatantrā sarvatantreśī dakṣiṇāmūrtirūpiṇī
sanakādisamārādhyā śivajñānapradāyinī

141

चित्कला ऽऽनन्दकलिका प्रेमरूपा प्रियङ्करी ।
नामपारायणप्रीता नन्दिविद्या नटेश्वरी ॥ १४१ ॥

citkalā ''nandakalikā premarūpā priyaṅkarī
nāmapārāyaṇaprītā nandividyā naṭeśvarī

142

मिथ्याजगदधिष्ठाना मुक्तिदा मुक्तिरूपिणी ।
लास्यप्रिया लयकरी लज्जा रम्भादिवन्दिता ॥ १४२ ॥

mithyājagadadhiṣṭhānā muktidā muktirūpiṇī
lāsyapriyā layakarī lajjā rambhādivanditā

143

भवदावसुधावृष्टिः पापारण्यदवानला ।
दौर्भाग्यतूलवातूला जराध्वान्तरविप्रभा ॥ १४३ ॥

bhavadāvasudhāvṛṣṭiḥ pāpāraṇyadavānalā
daurbhāgyatūlavātūlā jarādhvāntaraviprabhā

144

भाग्याब्धिचन्द्रिका भक्तचित्तकेकिघनाघना ।
रोगपर्वतदम्भोलिर् मृत्युदारुकुठारिका ॥ १४४ ॥

bhāgyābdhicandrikā bhaktacittakekighanāghanā
rogaparvatadambholir mṛtyudārukuṭhārikā

145

महेश्वरी महाकाली महाग्रासा महाशना ।
अपर्णा चण्डिका चण्डमुण्डासुरनिषूदिनी ॥ १४५ ॥

maheśvarī mahākālī mahāgrāsā mahāśanā
aparṇā caṇḍikā caṇḍamuṇḍāsuraniṣūdinī

146

क्षराक्षरात्मिका सर्वलोकेशी विश्वधारिणी ।
त्रिवर्गदात्री सुभगा त्र्यम्बका त्रिगुणात्मिका ॥ १४६ ॥

kṣarākṣarātmikā sarvalokeśī viśvadhāriṇī
trivargadātrī subhagā tryambakā triguṇātmikā

147

स्वर्गापवर्गदा शुद्धा जपापुष्पनिभाकृतिः ।
ओजोवती द्युतिधरा यज्ञरूपा प्रियव्रता ॥ १४७ ॥

svargāpavargadā śuddhā japāpuṣpanibhākṛtiḥ
ojovatī dyutidharā yajñarūpā priyavratā

148

दुराराध्या दुराधर्षा पाटलीकुसुमप्रिया ।
महती मेरुनिलया मन्दारकुसुमप्रिया ॥ १४८ ॥

durārādhyā durādharṣā pāṭalīkusumapriyā
mahatī merunilayā mandārakusumapriyā

149

वीराराध्या विराड्रूपा विरजा विश्वतोमुखी ।
प्रत्यग्रूपा पराकाशा प्राणदा प्राणरूपिणी ॥ १४९ ॥

vīrārādhyā virāḍrūpā virajā viśvatomukhī
pratyagrūpā parākāśā prāṇadā prāṇarūpiṇī

150

The 1,000 names, śloka by śloka

Śloka 1names 1–5

श्रीमाता श्रीमहाराज्ञी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी ।
चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता देवकार्यसमुद्यता ॥ १ ॥

śrīmātā śrīmahārājñī śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī |
cidagnikuṇḍasambhūtā devakāryasamudyatā || 1 ||

The names, separated

1श्री-माताśrī-mātā2श्री-महा-राज्ञीśrī-mahā-rājñī3श्रीमत्-सिंहासनेश्वरीśrīmat-siṃhāsaneśvarī

4चिद्-अग्नि-कुण्ड-सम्भूताcid-agni-kuṇḍa-sambhūtā5देव-कार्य-समुद्यताdeva-kārya-samudyatā

Translation

1She who is the auspicious Mother; 2She who is the auspicious great Empress; 3She who is the queen of the most glorious throne;

4She who arose from the fire-altar of pure consciousness; 5She who is intent on accomplishing the task of the gods.

Word by word

SanskritEnglish

श्रीśrīauspiciousness, glory, splendor; also the goddess Śrī (Lakṣmī)

श्रीśrīauspicious, glorious (honorific)

देवdevagod

समुद्यताsamudyatāready, intent upon, set to worksam + ud + √yam 'to raise', past participle, feminine: lit. 'with arms raised for the work'

Where the names meet

Names 1–3 each open with śrī/śrīmat and are traditionally read together as creation, maintenance and dissolution; names 4–5 begin the Purāṇic account of Her appearance from the fire for the gods' task.

The names

1 श्रीमाता śrī-mātā

She who is the auspicious Mother

Sandhi none inside the name; the parts stand as written

Compound karmadhāraya (śrī as qualifying/honorific first member); alternatively ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa. Two analyses are current, and both make mātā 'mother' the head. As a karmadhāraya, śrī stands in apposition to mātā: 'the Mother who is Śrī', i.e. auspicious, glorious, the source of all prosperity. As a ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, śrī is the goddess Śrī (Lakṣmī): 'the mother of Śrī'. Śrī and mātā are simply juxtaposed; there is no sound change.

Analysis श्रीः माता श्रीमाता (श्रीः च असौ माता च); अथवा श्रियः माता श्रीमाता
śrīḥ mātā śrīmātā (śrīḥ ca asau mātā ca); athavā śriyaḥ mātā śrīmātā

Significance Traditionally the first three names are read together as the three cosmic functions: as Mother She brings forth the worlds (sṛṣṭi), as Empress She sustains them (sthiti), and as Sovereign of the lion-throne She withdraws them (saṃhāra). She is Mother even of Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī.

Uncertain Two compound analyses are current: karmadhāraya ('the auspicious Mother') and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa ('Mother of Śrī/Lakṣmī'). The meaning follows the first; the second is given in the samāsa note.

2 श्रीमहाराज्ञी śrī-mahā-rājñī

She who is the auspicious great Empress

Sandhi none inside the name; the parts stand as written

Compound karmadhāraya (with an inner karmadhāraya). Inner layer: mahatī rājñī 'the great queen'. In a karmadhāraya the feminine adjective mahatī takes its masculine stem (puṃvadbhāva, Pāṇini 6.3.42), and mahat then becomes mahā- before a co-referential member (6.3.46 ān mahataḥ samānādhikaraṇa-jātīyayoḥ): mahā-rājñī. Rājñī is the feminine of rājan 'king' and is the head. Outer layer: śrī qualifies mahārājñī as in name 1. These are morphological replacements, not sound-sandhi; the members meet without phonetic change.

Analysis महती राज्ञी महाराज्ञी; श्रीः महाराज्ञी श्रीमहाराज्ञी
mahatī rājñī mahārājñī; śrīḥ mahārājñī śrīmahārājñī

Significance Traditionally the second of the three opening names: as Empress She sustains and governs all the worlds (sthiti) that She brought forth as Mother.

3 श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी śrīmat-siṃhāsaneśvarī

She who is the queen of the most glorious throne

Sandhi सिंहासन = सिंह + आसन (siṃha + āsana) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ), inside the lexicalised compound siṃhāsana 'throne'; सिंहासनेश्वरी = सिंहासन + ईश्वरी (siṃhāsana + īśvarī) — guṇa: a + ī → e (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)

Compound ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa (with an inner karmadhāraya). Inner layer: the adjective śrīmat 'glorious' qualifies siṃhāsana 'lion-seat, throne' (karmadhāraya). Outer layer: īśvarī 'sovereign, ruling lady' is the head and the throne stands to it in the genitive relation: 'the sovereign of the glorious throne'. Grammatically śrīmat could also qualify the sovereign herself (śrīmatī reduced to śrīmat by puṃvadbhāva), but the usual reading attaches it to the throne.

Analysis श्रीमत् सिंहासनम् श्रीमत्सिंहासनम्; श्रीमत्सिंहासनस्य ईश्वरी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी
śrīmat siṃhāsanam śrīmatsiṃhāsanam; śrīmatsiṃhāsanasya īśvarī śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī

Significance Traditionally the third of the opening triad, dissolution (saṃhāra): the One enthroned as supreme sovereign, into whom all that She created and sustained is finally withdrawn.

4 चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता cid-agni-kuṇḍa-sambhūtā

She who arose from the fire-altar of pure consciousness

Sandhi चिदग्नि = चित् + अग्नि (cit + agni) — jaśtva: a final t becomes d before a voiced sound (Pāṇini 8.2.39 jhalāṃ jaśo 'nte)

Compound pañcamī-tatpuruṣa (with an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and an inner karmadhāraya). Built in three layers. (1) cit-agni 'the fire that is consciousness': a karmadhāraya of identification (rūpaka) — consciousness itself is the fire. (2) cidagni-kuṇḍa 'the altar-pit of that fire': ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, kuṇḍa is the head. (3) The participle sambhūtā 'arisen' is the head of the whole and the fire-pit stands to it in the ablative: 'arisen from'. A locative reading (cidagnikuṇḍe sambhūtā, saptamī-tatpuruṣa, 'born in the fire-pit') is also current; the sense hardly changes.

Analysis चित् एव अग्निः चिदग्निः; चिदग्नेः कुण्डम् चिदग्निकुण्डम्; चिदग्निकुण्डात् सम्भूता चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता
cit eva agniḥ cidagniḥ; cidagneḥ kuṇḍam cidagnikuṇḍam; cidagnikuṇḍāt sambhūtā cidagnikuṇḍasambhūtā

Significance In the Lalitopākhyāna of the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa the Goddess appears from the sacrificial fire kindled by the gods for the war against Bhaṇḍa. Inwardly, the fire is consciousness itself, in which ignorance and duality are offered up.

Uncertain Ablative ('arisen from') and locative ('born in') analyses of the last member are both current.

5 देवकार्यसमुद्यता deva-kārya-samudyatā

She who is intent on accomplishing the task of the gods

Sandhi none inside the name; the parts stand as written

Compound saptamī-tatpuruṣa (with an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). Inner layer: deva-kārya 'the task of the gods' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, kārya is the head). Outer layer: the participle samudyatā 'ready, set upon, intent' is the head and governs the locative: 'intent upon the gods' task'. A caturthī reading ('ready for the sake of the gods' task') gives the same sense.

Analysis देवानाम् कार्यम् देवकार्यम्; देवकार्ये समुद्यता देवकार्यसमुद्यता
devānām kāryam devakāryam; devakārye samudyatā devakāryasamudyatā

Significance In the Purāṇa the gods' task is the destruction of the demon Bhaṇḍa, for which She arose (name 4). Traditionally it is also read as Her readiness to protect all who live by dharma.

Śloka 2names 6–9

उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता ।
रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला ॥ २ ॥

udyadbhānusahasrābhā caturbāhusamanvitā |
rāgasvarūpapāśāḍhyā krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā || 2 ||

The names, separated

8राग-स्वरूप-पाशाढ्याrāga-svarūpa-pāśāḍhyā9क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वलाkrodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

Translation

6She who has the radiance of a thousand rising suns; 7She who is four-armed;

8She who holds the noose whose very nature is desire (rāga); 9She who is resplendent with the goad that has the form of anger.

Where the names meet

Names 8–11 (running into śloka 3) name the four emblems held in the four hands of name 7.

The names

6 उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा udyad-bhānu-sahasrābhā

She who has the radiance of a thousand rising suns

Sandhi उद्यद्भानु = उद्यत् + भानु (udyat + bhānu) — jaśtva: a final t becomes d before a voiced sound (Pāṇini 8.2.39 jhalāṃ jaśo 'nte); सहस्राभा = सहस्र + आभा (sahasra + ābhā) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound bahuvrīhi of comparison (over an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and an inner karmadhāraya). (1) udyad-bhānu 'rising sun(s)': the present participle udyat qualifies bhānu (karmadhāraya). (2) udyadbhānu-sahasra 'a thousand rising suns' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, sahasra is the head). (3) The whole is a bahuvrīhi describing Her: 'She whose radiance (ābhā) is like that of a thousand rising suns'. The name could also be taken as a tatpuruṣa in apposition ('She who is the radiance of …'); the image is the same.

Analysis उद्यन्तः भानवः उद्यद्भानवः; उद्यद्भानूनाम् सहस्रम् उद्यद्भानुसहस्रम्; उद्यद्भानुसहस्रस्य आभा इव आभा यस्याः सा उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा
udyantaḥ bhānavaḥ udyadbhānavaḥ; udyadbhānūnām sahasram udyadbhānusahasram; udyadbhānusahasrasya ābhā iva ābhā yasyāḥ sā udyadbhānusahasrābhā

Significance The crimson of the rising sun is Her own color throughout the hymn; 'a thousand' is traditionally taken to mean beyond counting, a brilliance that is nonetheless gentle like dawn.

7 चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता catur-bāhu-samanvitā

She who is four-armed

Sandhi अन्विता = अनु + इता (anu + itā) — yaṇ: u becomes v before a dissimilar vowel (Pāṇini 6.1.77 iko yaṇ aci), at the junction of the prefix anu with ita

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (with an inner dvigu). Inner layer: catur-bāhu 'four arms', a numeral + noun karmadhāraya, i.e. a dvigu, allowed here because another member follows (Pāṇini 2.1.51–52). Outer layer: the participle samanvitā 'endowed with' is the head and the four arms stand to it in the instrumental. The r of catur is original, so it stays r before the voiced b; no visarga arises.

Analysis चत्वारः बाहवः चतुर्बाहवः; चतुर्भिः बाहुभिः समन्विता चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता
catvāraḥ bāhavaḥ caturbāhavaḥ; caturbhiḥ bāhubhiḥ samanvitā caturbāhusamanvitā

Significance The four arms carry the four emblems named next: the noose, the goad, the sugarcane bow and the flower arrows (names 8–11).

8 रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या rāga-svarūpa-pāśāḍhyā

She who holds the noose whose very nature is desire (rāga)

Sandhi पाशाढ्या = पाश + आढ्या (pāśa + āḍhyā) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner karmadhāraya and an inner bahuvrīhi). (1) rāga-svarūpa 'whose very nature is desire' — a bahuvrīhi that qualifies the noose. (2) rāgasvarūpa-pāśa 'the noose whose nature is desire' (karmadhāraya, pāśa is the head). (3) āḍhyā 'rich in, furnished with' is the head of the whole and takes the noose in the instrumental: 'furnished with that noose'.

Analysis रागः स्वरूपम् यस्य सः रागस्वरूपः; रागस्वरूपः पाशः रागस्वरूपपाशः; रागस्वरूपपाशेन आढ्या रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या
rāgaḥ svarūpam yasya saḥ rāgasvarūpaḥ; rāgasvarūpaḥ pāśaḥ rāgasvarūpapāśaḥ; rāgasvarūpapāśena āḍhyā rāgasvarūpapāśāḍhyā

Significance In Śrīvidyā the noose is commonly read as icchā-śakti, the power of will: the binding pull of attachment is itself held in Her hand, so She can bind devotees to Herself and loosen worldly ties.

9 क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

She who is resplendent with the goad that has the form of anger

Sandhi क्रोधाकार = क्रोध + आकार (krodha + ākāra) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); आकाराङ्कुश = आकार + अङ्कुश (ākāra + aṅkuśa) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); अङ्कुशोज्ज्वला = अङ्कुश + उज्ज्वला (aṅkuśa + ujjvalā) — guṇa: a + u → o (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ); उज्ज्वला = उद् + ज्वला (ud + jvalā) — the prefix ud assimilates to the following palatal: d becomes j before j (ścutva, Pāṇini 8.4.40 stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ)

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner karmadhāraya and an inner bahuvrīhi). Parallel to name 8. (1) krodha-ākāra 'whose form is anger' — a bahuvrīhi qualifying the goad. (2) krodhākāra-aṅkuśa 'the goad that has the form of anger' (karmadhāraya). (3) ujjvalā 'blazing, resplendent' is the head and takes the goad in the instrumental: 'resplendent with that goad'. Every junction fuses its vowels, so the name cannot be hyphenated.

Analysis क्रोधः आकारः यस्य सः क्रोधाकारः; क्रोधाकारः अङ्कुशः क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशः; क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशेन उज्ज्वला क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला
krodhaḥ ākāraḥ yasya saḥ krodhākāraḥ; krodhākāraḥ aṅkuśaḥ krodhākārāṅkuśaḥ; krodhākārāṅkuśena ujjvalā krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

Significance The goad restrains and directs, as the noose binds. In Śrīvidyā it is commonly read as jñāna-śakti, the power of knowledge; anger itself, held by Her, becomes a force that curbs what is wrong.

मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा पञ्चतन्मात्रसायका ।
निजारुणप्रभापूरमज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ ३ ॥

manorūpekṣukodaṇḍā pañcatanmātrasāyakā |
nijāruṇaprabhāpūramajjadbrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā || 3 ||

10She who holds in Her hand a sugarcane bow that represents the mind; 11She who holds the five subtle elements as arrows;

12She in the flood of whose own crimson radiance the whole sphere of the universe is immersed.

Where the names meet

Name 12 fills the whole second half; its participle majjat 'sinking' is intransitive (the universe is immersed).

The names

10 मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा mano-rūpekṣu-kodaṇḍā

She who holds in Her hand a sugarcane bow that represents the mind

Sandhi मनोरूप = मनस् + रूप (manas + rūpa) — visarga sandhi: final s becomes ru (Pāṇini 8.2.66 sasajuṣo ruḥ), which after a and before a voiced consonant becomes u (6.1.113–114 ato ror aplutād aplute, haśi ca); a + u then gives o (6.1.87); रूपेक्षु = रूप + इक्षु (rūpa + ikṣu) — guṇa: a + i → e (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, an inner bahuvrīhi and an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (1) mano-rūpa 'whose form is the mind' — a bahuvrīhi qualifying the bow. (2) ikṣu-kodaṇḍa 'bow of sugarcane' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa of material). (3) The two combine as a karmadhāraya, 'the sugarcane bow that is the mind'. (4) The whole is a bahuvrīhi describing Her, 'She whose bow is …'; kodaṇḍa takes the feminine ending -ā to agree with Her (Pāṇini 4.1.4 ajādyataṣ ṭāp).

Analysis मनः रूपम् यस्य सः मनोरूपः; इक्षोः कोदण्डः इक्षुकोदण्डः; मनोरूपः इक्षुकोदण्डः मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डः; मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डः यस्याः सा मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा
manaḥ rūpam yasya saḥ manorūpaḥ; ikṣoḥ kodaṇḍaḥ ikṣukodaṇḍaḥ; manorūpaḥ ikṣukodaṇḍaḥ manorūpekṣukodaṇḍaḥ; manorūpekṣukodaṇḍaḥ yasyāḥ sā manorūpekṣukodaṇḍā

Significance The sugarcane bow is Kāma's, made sweet; here it is the mind from which the arrows of the senses are loosed. In Śrīvidyā the bow and arrows together are commonly read as kriyā-śakti, the power of action.

11 पञ्चतन्मात्रसायका pañca-tanmātra-sāyakā

She who holds the five subtle elements as arrows

Sandhi तन्मात्र = तत् + मात्र (tat + mātra) — a stop becomes the nasal of its class before a nasal: t → n before m (Pāṇini 8.4.45 yaro 'nunāsike 'nunāsiko vā), inside the lexicalised compound tanmātra

Compound bahuvrīhi (with an inner dvigu). Inner layer: pañca-tanmātra 'the five subtle elements', a numeral compound (dvigu) before a further member. Outer layer: a bahuvrīhi, 'She whose arrows are the five subtle elements'; sāyaka takes the feminine -ā. The stem pañcan drops its final n in composition (Pāṇini 8.2.7 nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya).

Analysis पञ्च तन्मात्राणि पञ्चतन्मात्राणि; पञ्चतन्मात्राणि सायकाः यस्याः सा पञ्चतन्मात्रसायका
pañca tanmātrāṇi pañcatanmātrāṇi; pañcatanmātrāṇi sāyakāḥ yasyāḥ sā pañcatanmātrasāyakā

Significance Her five flower-arrows, again Kāma's, are the tanmātras — sound, touch, form, taste and smell — through which every experience reaches the mind (name 10).

12 निजारुणप्रभापूरमज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला nijāruṇa-prabhā-pūra-majjad-brahmāṇḍa-maṇḍalā

She in the flood of whose own crimson radiance the whole sphere of the universe is immersed

Sandhi निजारुण = निज + अरुण (nija + aruṇa) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); मज्जद्ब्रह्म = मज्जत् + ब्रह्म (majjat + brahma) — jaśtva: a final t becomes d before a voiced sound (Pāṇini 8.2.39 jhalāṃ jaśo 'nte); ब्रह्माण्ड = ब्रह्म + अण्ड (brahma + aṇḍa) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ), inside the lexicalised compound brahmāṇḍa (brahman drops its final n first, 8.2.7)

Compound bahuvrīhi (over inner karmadhāraya, ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and saptamī-tatpuruṣa layers). (1) nija-aruṇa-prabhā 'Her own crimson radiance' (karmadhāraya: two adjectives on prabhā). (2) …prabhā-pūra 'the flood of that radiance' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) …pūra-majjat 'sinking, bathing in that flood' (saptamī-tatpuruṣa; majjat is intransitive). (4) brahmāṇḍa-maṇḍala 'the round of the world-eggs', i.e. the whole universe (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa), qualified by the participle. (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She in the flood of whose own crimson radiance the sphere of the universe is immersed'; nija refers back to Her.

Analysis निजा अरुणा प्रभा निजारुणप्रभा; निजारुणप्रभायाः पूरः निजारुणप्रभापूरः; ब्रह्माण्डानाम् मण्डलम् ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम्; निजारुणप्रभापूरे मज्जत् ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम् यस्याः सा निजारुणप्रभापूरमज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला
nijā aruṇā prabhā nijāruṇaprabhā; nijāruṇaprabhāyāḥ pūraḥ nijāruṇaprabhāpūraḥ; brahmāṇḍānām maṇḍalam brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam; nijāruṇaprabhāpūre majjat brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam yasyāḥ sā nijāruṇaprabhāpūramajjadbrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā

Significance The red radiance of name 6 now fills everything: the universe bathes in Her light. In Śrīvidyā Her redness is traditionally read as compassion, the loving self-awareness (vimarśa) that colors all creation.

14कुरुविन्द-मणि-श्रेणी-कनत्-कोटीर-मण्डिताkuruvinda-maṇi-śreṇī-kanat-koṭīra-maṇḍitā

14She who is adorned with a crown sparkling with rows of kuruvinda rubies.

Where the names meet

From name 13 the names describe Her form from the hair downward; from here to śloka 10 each half-śloka is a single name.

The names

13 चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसौगन्धिकलसत्कचा campakāśoka-punnāga-saugandhika-lasat-kacā

She whose tresses shine with campaka, aśoka, punnāga and saugandhika flowers

Sandhi चम्पकाशोक = चम्पक + अशोक (campaka + aśoka) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner itaretara-dvandva, tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa and karmadhāraya). (1) The four flower names form an itaretara-dvandva, 'campaka, aśoka, punnāga and saugandhika (blossoms)'. (2) They stand in the instrumental to the participle lasat 'shining, playing' (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa). (3) lasat qualifies kaca 'hair, tresses' (karmadhāraya). (4) The whole is a bahuvrīhi describing Her: 'She whose tresses shine with …'; kaca takes the feminine -ā.

Analysis चम्पकः च अशोकः च पुन्नागः च सौगन्धिकम् च चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसौगन्धिकानि; चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसौगन्धिकैः लसन्तः कचाः यस्याः सा चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसौगन्धिकलसत्कचा
campakaḥ ca aśokaḥ ca punnāgaḥ ca saugandhikam ca campakāśokapunnāgasaugandhikāni; campakāśokapunnāgasaugandhikaiḥ lasantaḥ kacāḥ yasyāḥ sā campakāśokapunnāgasaugandhikalasatkacā

Significance Here begins the traditional description of Her form from the hair downward. It is traditionally said that the flowers do not perfume Her hair but take their fragrance from it.

14 कुरुविन्दमणिश्रेणीकनत्कोटीरमण्डिता kuruvinda-maṇi-śreṇī-kanat-koṭīra-maṇḍitā

She who is adorned with a crown sparkling with rows of kuruvinda rubies

Sandhi none inside the name; the parts stand as written

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over inner karmadhāraya, ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa layers). (1) kuruvinda-maṇi 'kuruvinda gems', i.e. rubies (karmadhāraya). (2) …maṇi-śreṇī 'a row of them' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) …śreṇī-kanat 'sparkling with that row' (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa with the participle kanat), which qualifies koṭīra 'crown' (karmadhāraya). (4) The past participle maṇḍitā 'adorned' is the head of the whole and takes the crown in the instrumental. The members meet without sound change.

Analysis कुरुविन्दाः मणयः कुरुविन्दमणयः; कुरुविन्दमणीनाम् श्रेणी कुरुविन्दमणिश्रेणी; कुरुविन्दमणिश्रेण्या कनत् कोटीरम् कुरुविन्दमणिश्रेणीकनत्कोटीरम्; तेन मण्डिता कुरुविन्दमणिश्रेणीकनत्कोटीरमण्डिता
kuruvindāḥ maṇayaḥ kuruvindamaṇayaḥ; kuruvindamaṇīnām śreṇī kuruvindamaṇiśreṇī; kuruvindamaṇiśreṇyā kanat koṭīram kuruvindamaṇiśreṇīkanatkoṭīram; tena maṇḍitā kuruvindamaṇiśreṇīkanatkoṭīramaṇḍitā

Significance The red of the rubies continues the crimson of Her radiance (names 6 and 12); the crown is the sign of the sovereignty named in names 2 and 3.

Where the names meet

Name 15: divide vibhrājad-alika ('shining forehead'), not vibhrāja-dalika; the d is the voiced t of the participle vibhrājat.

The names

15 अष्टमीचन्द्रविभ्राजदलिकस्थलशोभिता aṣṭamī-candra-vibhrājad-alika-sthala-śobhitā

She whose forehead shines like the half-moon of the eighth lunar day

Sandhi विभ्राजदलिक = विभ्राजत् + अलिक (vibhrājat + alika) — jaśtva: a final t becomes d at the end of a member, here before a vowel (Pāṇini 8.2.39 jhalāṃ jaśo 'nte)

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner upamāna-karmadhāraya, a karmadhāraya and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) aṣṭamī-candra 'the moon of the eighth lunar day', the half-moon (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) aṣṭamīcandra-vibhrājat 'shining like that moon': the standard of comparison compounded with the word for the shared quality (upamāna-karmadhāraya, Pāṇini 2.1.55 upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ, as in ghana-śyāma 'dark as a cloud'). (3) alika-sthala 'the expanse of the forehead' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa), qualified by (2) (karmadhāraya). (4) The participle śobhitā 'beautified' is the head and takes the forehead in the instrumental.

Analysis अष्टम्याः चन्द्रः अष्टमीचन्द्रः; अष्टमीचन्द्रः इव विभ्राजत् अष्टमीचन्द्रविभ्राजत्; अलिकस्य स्थलम् अलिकस्थलम्; अष्टमीचन्द्रविभ्राजत् अलिकस्थलम् अष्टमीचन्द्रविभ्राजदलिकस्थलम्; तेन शोभिता अष्टमीचन्द्रविभ्राजदलिकस्थलशोभिता
aṣṭamyāḥ candraḥ aṣṭamīcandraḥ; aṣṭamīcandraḥ iva vibhrājat aṣṭamīcandravibhrājat; alikasya sthalam alikasthalam; aṣṭamīcandravibhrājat alikasthalam aṣṭamīcandravibhrājadalikasthalam; tena śobhitā aṣṭamīcandravibhrājadalikasthalaśobhitā

Significance The eighth-day moon is an exact half-disc, the classical poets' image for a broad, curved, luminous forehead.

16 मुखचन्द्रकलङ्काभमृगनाभिविशेषका mukha-candra-kalaṅkābha-mṛga-nābhi-viśeṣakā

She whose musk tilaka looks like the dark mark on the moon of Her face

Sandhi कलङ्काभ = कलङ्क + आभ (kalaṅka + ābha) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, a bahuvrīhi of resemblance, a rūpaka-karmadhāraya and ṣaṣṭhī-/tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣas). (1) mukha-candra 'the moon that is (Her) face' (rūpaka-karmadhāraya: the face is identified with the moon). (2) …candra-kalaṅka 'the dark mark on that moon' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) …kalaṅka-ābha 'looking like that mark' (bahuvrīhi of resemblance), qualifying (4) mṛganābhi-viśeṣaka 'a forehead-mark (tilaka) of musk' (mṛga-nābhi 'deer's navel' = musk, then a tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa of material). (3) and (4) form a karmadhāraya. (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose musk tilaka looks like the mark on the moon of Her face'.

Analysis मुखम् एव चन्द्रः मुखचन्द्रः; मुखचन्द्रस्य कलङ्कः मुखचन्द्रकलङ्कः; मुखचन्द्रकलङ्कस्य आभा इव आभा यस्य सः मुखचन्द्रकलङ्काभः; मृगस्य नाभिः मृगनाभिः; मृगनाभिना कृतः विशेषकः मृगनाभिविशेषकः; मुखचन्द्रकलङ्काभः मृगनाभिविशेषकः यस्याः सा मुखचन्द्रकलङ्काभमृगनाभिविशेषका
mukham eva candraḥ mukhacandraḥ; mukhacandrasya kalaṅkaḥ mukhacandrakalaṅkaḥ; mukhacandrakalaṅkasya ābhā iva ābhā yasya saḥ mukhacandrakalaṅkābhaḥ; mṛgasya nābhiḥ mṛganābhiḥ; mṛganābhinā kṛtaḥ viśeṣakaḥ mṛganābhiviśeṣakaḥ; mukhacandrakalaṅkābhaḥ mṛganābhiviśeṣakaḥ yasyāḥ sā mukhacandrakalaṅkābhamṛganābhiviśeṣakā

Significance The face is the full moon and the dark musk mark on the forehead is its 'spot': the blemish of the real moon becomes an ornament on Hers.

Where the names meet

Both names are layered bahuvrīhis built on an identification: the face as Kāma's festive house (17), the face's beauty as a stream (18).

The names

17 वदनस्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहतोरणचिल्लिका vadana-smara-māṅgalya-gṛha-toraṇa-cillikā

She whose eyebrows are like the arched gateway of Her face, the festive mansion of Kāma

Sandhi none inside the name; the parts stand as written

Compound bahuvrīhi of comparison (over a rūpaka-karmadhāraya, a karmadhāraya and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) māṅgalya-gṛha 'festive, auspicious house' (karmadhāraya). (2) smara-… 'Kāma's festive house' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) vadana-… 'the face, which is Kāma's festive house' (rūpaka-karmadhāraya). (4) …gṛha-toraṇa 'the arched gateway of that house' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (5) A bahuvrīhi of comparison: 'She whose eyebrows are (like) that gateway'. The feminine cillikā, as a subordinate final member, is shortened (Pāṇini 1.2.48 gostriyor upasarjanasya) and then takes -ā again to agree with Her.

Analysis माङ्गल्यम् गृहम् माङ्गल्यगृहम्; स्मरस्य माङ्गल्यगृहम् स्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहम्; वदनम् एव स्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहम् वदनस्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहम्; वदनस्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहस्य तोरणम् वदनस्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहतोरणम्; तत् इव चिल्लिके यस्याः सा वदनस्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहतोरणचिल्लिका
māṅgalyam gṛham māṅgalyagṛham; smarasya māṅgalyagṛham smaramāṅgalyagṛham; vadanam eva smaramāṅgalyagṛham vadanasmaramāṅgalyagṛham; vadanasmaramāṅgalyagṛhasya toraṇam vadanasmaramāṅgalyagṛhatoraṇam; tat iva cillike yasyāḥ sā vadanasmaramāṅgalyagṛhatoraṇacillikā

Significance The curve of Her brows is the toraṇa hung over the door of a house on a festive day. In Śrīvidyā Kāma is counted among Her foremost worshippers, so Her face is fittingly his house of celebration.

18 वक्त्रलक्ष्मीपरीवाहचलन्मीनाभलोचना vaktra-lakṣmī-parīvāha-calan-mīnābha-locanā

She whose eyes are like fish darting in the overflowing stream of the beauty of Her face

Sandhi चलन्मीन = चलत् + मीन (calat + mīna) — a stop becomes the nasal of its class before a nasal: t → n before m (Pāṇini 8.4.45 yaro 'nunāsike 'nunāsiko vā); मीनाभ = मीन + आभ (mīna + ābha) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner bahuvrīhi of resemblance, a karmadhāraya, a saptamī-tatpuruṣa and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) vaktra-lakṣmī 'the beauty of the face' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa; lakṣmī here means beauty, not the goddess). (2) …lakṣmī-parīvāha 'the overflowing stream of that beauty' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) …parīvāha-calat 'darting in that stream' (saptamī-tatpuruṣa with the participle), qualifying mīna 'fish' (karmadhāraya). (4) …mīna-ābha 'looking like those fish' (bahuvrīhi of resemblance), qualifying locana 'eye'. (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose eyes are like fish darting in the stream of Her face's beauty'.

Analysis वक्त्रस्य लक्ष्मीः वक्त्रलक्ष्मीः; वक्त्रलक्ष्म्याः परीवाहः वक्त्रलक्ष्मीपरीवाहः; वक्त्रलक्ष्मीपरीवाहे चलन्तौ मीनौ; तयोः आभा इव आभा ययोः ते वक्त्रलक्ष्मीपरीवाहचलन्मीनाभे लोचने; ते लोचने यस्याः सा वक्त्रलक्ष्मीपरीवाहचलन्मीनाभलोचना
vaktrasya lakṣmīḥ vaktralakṣmīḥ; vaktralakṣmyāḥ parīvāhaḥ vaktralakṣmīparīvāhaḥ; vaktralakṣmīparīvāhe calantau mīnau; tayoḥ ābhā iva ābhā yayoḥ te vaktralakṣmīparīvāhacalanmīnābhe locane; te locane yasyāḥ sā vaktralakṣmīparīvāhacalanmīnābhalocanā

Significance The fish-eyed Goddess (compare the name Mīnākṣī): traditionally fish are said to nourish their young by their gaze alone, and so Her glance alone sustains Her devotees.

The names

19 नवचम्पकपुष्पाभनासादण्डविराजिता nava-campaka-puṣpābha-nāsā-daṇḍa-virājitā

She who is resplendent with a nose that has the beauty of a newly blossoming campaka flower

Sandhi पुष्पाभ = पुष्प + आभ (puṣpa + ābha) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner karmadhāraya, a bahuvrīhi of resemblance and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) nava-campakapuṣpa 'a fresh campaka blossom' (karmadhāraya over the ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa campaka-puṣpa). (2) …puṣpa-ābha 'resembling that blossom' (bahuvrīhi of resemblance), qualifying (3) nāsā-daṇḍa 'the staff of the nose', i.e. its straight ridge (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (4) The participle virājitā 'shining, made resplendent' is the head and takes the nose in the instrumental.

Analysis चम्पकस्य पुष्पम् चम्पकपुष्पम्; नवम् चम्पकपुष्पम् नवचम्पकपुष्पम्; नवचम्पकपुष्पस्य आभा इव आभा यस्य सः नवचम्पकपुष्पाभः; नासायाः दण्डः नासादण्डः; नवचम्पकपुष्पाभः नासादण्डः नवचम्पकपुष्पाभनासादण्डः; तेन विराजिता नवचम्पकपुष्पाभनासादण्डविराजिता
campakasya puṣpam campakapuṣpam; navam campakapuṣpam navacampakapuṣpam; navacampakapuṣpasya ābhā iva ābhā yasya saḥ navacampakapuṣpābhaḥ; nāsāyāḥ daṇḍaḥ nāsādaṇḍaḥ; navacampakapuṣpābhaḥ nāsādaṇḍaḥ navacampakapuṣpābhanāsādaṇḍaḥ; tena virājitā navacampakapuṣpābhanāsādaṇḍavirājitā

Significance A classical comparison: the slender, straight nose is likened to a fresh campaka bud, long and delicately colored.

20 ताराकान्तितिरस्कारिनासाभरणभासुरा tārā-kānti-tiraskāri-nāsābharaṇa-bhāsurā

She who shines with a nose-ornament that excels the luster of a star

Sandhi तिरस्कारि = तिरस् + कारि (tiras + kāri) — the final s of tiras is kept as s before k instead of becoming visarga (optional, Pāṇini 8.3.42 tiraso 'nyatarasyām); नासाभरण = नासा + आभरण (nāsā + ābharaṇa) — savarṇa-dīrgha: ā + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner karmadhāraya, an upapada-tatpuruṣa and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) tārā-kānti 'the brilliance of the stars' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) …kānti-tiraskārin 'putting that brilliance to shame': an agent noun in -in from tiras + √kṛ, compounded with its object (upapada-tatpuruṣa); it loses its final n in composition (8.2.7). (3) It qualifies nāsā-ābharaṇa 'nose-ornament' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa) as a karmadhāraya. (4) bhāsurā 'radiant' is the head and takes the ornament in the instrumental.

Analysis ताराणाम् कान्तिः ताराकान्तिः; ताराकान्तिम् तिरस्करोति इति ताराकान्तितिरस्कारि; नासायाः आभरणम् नासाभरणम्; ताराकान्तितिरस्कारि नासाभरणम् ताराकान्तितिरस्कारिनासाभरणम्; तेन भासुरा ताराकान्तितिरस्कारिनासाभरणभासुरा
tārāṇām kāntiḥ tārākāntiḥ; tārākāntim tiraskaroti iti tārākāntitiraskāri; nāsāyāḥ ābharaṇam nāsābharaṇam; tārākāntitiraskāri nāsābharaṇam tārākāntitiraskārināsābharaṇam; tena bhāsurā tārākāntitiraskārināsābharaṇabhāsurā

Significance The jewel of Her nose-ornament outshines the stars; traditionally the ornament is pictured as set with a pearl or gem.

Śloka 8names 21–22

कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तकर्णपूरमनोहरा ।
ताटङ्कयुगलीभूततपनोडुपमण्डला ॥ ८ ॥

kadambamañjarīkḷptakarṇapūramanoharā |
tāṭaṅkayugalībhūtatapanoḍupamaṇḍalā || 8 ||

The names, separated

21कदम्ब-मञ्जरी-कॢप्त-कर्णपूर-मनोहराkadamba-mañjarī-kḷpta-karṇapūra-manoharā

22ताटङ्क-युगली-भूत-तपनोडुप-मण्डलाtāṭaṅka-yugalī-bhūta-tapanoḍupa-maṇḍalā

Translation

21She who is captivating with ear-ornaments fashioned from clusters of kadamba blossoms;

22She for whom the discs of the sun and the moon have become a pair of earrings.

Word by word

SanskritEnglish

ताटङ्कtāṭaṅkalarge round earring

Where the names meet

Name 21 is spelled with vocalic ḷ: कॢप्त (kḷpta), the participle of √kḷp; karṇapūra 'ear-ornament' is one word.

The names

21 कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तकर्णपूरमनोहरा kadamba-mañjarī-kḷpta-karṇapūra-manoharā

She who is captivating with ear-ornaments fashioned from clusters of kadamba blossoms

Sandhi मनोहरा = मनस् + हरा (manas + harā) — visarga sandhi: final s becomes ru (Pāṇini 8.2.66), which after a and before a voiced consonant becomes u (6.1.114 haśi ca); a + u then gives o (6.1.87) — inside the lexicalised compound manohara

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner karmadhāraya, a tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa and a ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (1) kadamba-mañjarī 'clusters of kadamba blossom' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) …mañjarī-kḷpta 'fashioned from those clusters': an instrument compounded with a past participle (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa, Pāṇini 2.1.32 kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam). (3) It qualifies karṇapūra 'ear-ornament' (karmadhāraya). (4) manoharā 'captivating' is the head and takes the ornament in the instrumental: 'captivating with …'.

Analysis कदम्बस्य मञ्जर्यः कदम्बमञ्जर्यः; कदम्बमञ्जरीभिः कॢप्तः कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तः; कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तः कर्णपूरः कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तकर्णपूरः; तेन मनोहरा कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तकर्णपूरमनोहरा
kadambasya mañjaryaḥ kadambamañjaryaḥ; kadambamañjarībhiḥ kḷptaḥ kadambamañjarīkḷptaḥ; kadambamañjarīkḷptaḥ karṇapūraḥ kadambamañjarīkḷptakarṇapūraḥ; tena manoharā kadambamañjarīkḷptakarṇapūramanoharā

Significance The kadamba is Her tree: She dwells in the kadamba forest (kadambavana) of Her island-city, and its blossoms adorn Her ears.

Variants Many printed editions spell the participle क्लृप्त (klṛpta); कॢप्त (kḷpta) is the correct form, as in name 648.

Corrected कदम्बमञ्जरीक्लृप्तकर्णपूरमनोहरा → कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तकर्णपूरमनोहरा. klṛpta → kḷpta: the participle of √kḷp is kḷpta (vocalic ḷ); the verse text already reads कॢप्त, as does name 648.

22 ताटङ्कयुगलीभूततपनोडुपमण्डला tāṭaṅka-yugalī-bhūta-tapanoḍupa-maṇḍalā

She for whom the discs of the sun and the moon have become a pair of earrings

Sandhi तपनोडुप = तपन + उडुप (tapana + uḍupa) — guṇa: a + u → o (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, a gati-samāsa with a cvi form, an itaretara-dvandva and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) tāṭaṅka-yugala 'a pair of earrings' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) With the suffix cvi ('becoming what it was not') its final a becomes ī (Pāṇini 7.4.32 asya cvau), and the cvi form, a gati (1.4.61), compounds with bhūta 'become' (2.2.18 kugatiprādayaḥ): tāṭaṅkayugalī-bhūta 'turned into a pair of earrings'. (3) tapana-uḍupa 'sun and moon' (itaretara-dvandva) + maṇḍala 'disc' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (4) (2) qualifies (3) (karmadhāraya). (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She for whom the discs of sun and moon have become a pair of earrings'.

Analysis ताटङ्कयोः युगलम् ताटङ्कयुगलम्; अताटङ्कयुगलम् ताटङ्कयुगलम् भूते ताटङ्कयुगलीभूते; तपनः च उडुपः च तपनोडुपौ; तपनोडुपयोः मण्डले तपनोडुपमण्डले; ताटङ्कयुगलीभूते तपनोडुपमण्डले यस्याः सा ताटङ्कयुगलीभूततपनोडुपमण्डला
tāṭaṅkayoḥ yugalam tāṭaṅkayugalam; atāṭaṅkayugalam tāṭaṅkayugalam bhūte tāṭaṅkayugalībhūte; tapanaḥ ca uḍupaḥ ca tapanoḍupau; tapanoḍupayoḥ maṇḍale tapanoḍupamaṇḍale; tāṭaṅkayugalībhūte tapanoḍupamaṇḍale yasyāḥ sā tāṭaṅkayugalībhūtatapanoḍupamaṇḍalā

Significance Sun and moon are mere ornaments of Her cosmic form. The earrings are also the sign of auspicious wedded life: Saundaryalaharī 28 says Śiva survived the poison he swallowed by the power of Her tāṭaṅka.

Śloka 9names 23–24

नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारिरदनच्छदा ॥ ९ ॥

padmarāgaśilādarśaparibhāvikapolabhūḥ |

The names, separated

23पद्मराग-शिलादर्श-परिभावि-कपोल-भूःpadmarāga-śilādarśa-paribhāvi-kapola-bhūḥ

24नव-विद्रुम-बिम्ब-श्री-न्यक्कारि-रदनच्छदाnava-vidruma-bimba-śrī-nyakkāri-radanacchadā

Translation

23She whose cheeks outshine mirrors made of ruby (padmarāga);

24She whose lips put to shame the beauty of fresh coral and of the bimba fruit.

आदर्शādarśamirror

24 नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारिरदनच्छदा nava-vidruma-bimba-śrī-nyakkāri-radanacchadā

Where the names meet

Name 23 ends in the ū-stem bhū, so its nominative ends -bhūḥ, not -ā; the visarga stands at the half-line break.

The names

23 पद्मरागशिलादर्शपरिभाविकपोलभूः padmarāga-śilādarśa-paribhāvi-kapola-bhūḥ

She whose cheeks outshine mirrors made of ruby (padmarāga)

Sandhi शिलादर्श = शिला + आदर्श (śilā + ādarśa) — savarṇa-dīrgha: ā + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, an upapada-tatpuruṣa and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) padmarāga-śilā 'a slab of ruby' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) …śilā-ādarśa 'a mirror made of such a slab' (karmadhāraya with the middle word -maya dropped). (3) …ādarśa-paribhāvin 'surpassing that mirror' (upapada-tatpuruṣa; agent noun in -in from pari + √bhū). (4) kapola-bhū 'the expanse of the cheeks' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose cheeks surpass …'. The feminine paribhāvinī takes the masculine stem in the bahuvrīhi (Pāṇini 6.3.34) and drops its n (8.2.7); bhū is not a feminine-suffix stem, so it is not shortened and keeps its nominative -bhūḥ.

Analysis पद्मरागस्य शिला पद्मरागशिला; पद्मरागशिलामयः आदर्शः पद्मरागशिलादर्शः; पद्मरागशिलादर्शम् परिभवति इति पद्मरागशिलादर्शपरिभाविनी; कपोलयोः भूः कपोलभूः; पद्मरागशिलादर्शपरिभाविनी कपोलभूः यस्याः सा पद्मरागशिलादर्शपरिभाविकपोलभूः
padmarāgasya śilā padmarāgaśilā; padmarāgaśilāmayaḥ ādarśaḥ padmarāgaśilādarśaḥ; padmarāgaśilādarśam paribhavati iti padmarāgaśilādarśaparibhāvinī; kapolayoḥ bhūḥ kapolabhūḥ; padmarāgaśilādarśaparibhāvinī kapolabhūḥ yasyāḥ sā padmarāgaśilādarśaparibhāvikapolabhūḥ

Significance Her cheeks are so clear and rosy that they put to shame mirrors of polished ruby — the red of Her form once more, now as a reflecting surface.

24 नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारिरदनच्छदा nava-vidruma-bimba-śrī-nyakkāri-radanacchadā

She whose lips put to shame the beauty of fresh coral and of the bimba fruit

Sandhi रदनच्छदा = रदन + छदा (radana + chadā) — after a short vowel, ch is preceded by the augment t (Pāṇini 6.1.73 che ca), which becomes c before ch (8.4.40 stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ): -acch-

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, an itaretara-dvandva, an upapada-tatpuruṣa and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) nava-vidruma 'fresh coral' (karmadhāraya). (2) …vidruma-bimba 'fresh coral and the bimba fruit' (itaretara-dvandva). (3) …bimba-śrī 'their beauty' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (4) …śrī-nyakkārin 'humbling that beauty' (upapada-tatpuruṣa; agent noun in -in from nyak + √kṛ, final n dropped). (5) radana-chada 'the covering of the teeth', i.e. the lip (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa), qualified by (4). (6) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose lips humble the beauty of fresh coral and the bimba fruit'.

Analysis नवः विद्रुमः नवविद्रुमः; नवविद्रुमः च बिम्बम् च नवविद्रुमबिम्बे; नवविद्रुमबिम्बयोः श्रीः नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीः; नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रियम् न्यक्करोति इति नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारी; रदनानाम् छदः रदनच्छदः; नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारिणौ रदनच्छदौ यस्याः सा नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारिरदनच्छदा
navaḥ vidrumaḥ navavidrumaḥ; navavidrumaḥ ca bimbam ca navavidrumabimbe; navavidrumabimbayoḥ śrīḥ navavidrumabimbaśrīḥ; navavidrumabimbaśriyam nyakkaroti iti navavidrumabimbaśrīnyakkārī; radanānām chadaḥ radanacchadaḥ; navavidrumabimbaśrīnyakkāriṇau radanacchadau yasyāḥ sā navavidrumabimbaśrīnyakkāriradanacchadā

Significance Coral and the ripe bimba are the poets' standard images for red lips; Hers surpass both.

अन्तराantarāinterval, reach, regionantara, with the feminine -ā of the bahuvrīhi

Where the names meet

Name 26: vīṭikāmoda is vīṭikā + āmoda 'fragrance' (the long ā absorbs āmoda's initial ā).

The names

25 शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकारद्विजपङ्क्तिद्वयोज्ज्वला śuddha-vidyāṅkurākāra-dvija-paṅkti-dvayojjvalā

She who is resplendent with two rows of teeth shaped like the sprouts of pure knowledge (śuddhavidyā)

Sandhi विद्याङ्कुर = विद्या + अङ्कुर (vidyā + aṅkura) — savarṇa-dīrgha: ā + a → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); अङ्कुराकार = अङ्कुर + आकार (aṅkura + ākāra) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); द्वयोज्ज्वला = द्वय + उज्ज्वला (dvaya + ujjvalā) — guṇa: a + u → o (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ); उज्ज्वला = उद् + ज्वला (ud + jvalā) — the prefix ud assimilates to the following palatal: d becomes j before j (ścutva, Pāṇini 8.4.40 stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ)

Compound tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over inner karmadhārayas, a bahuvrīhi of resemblance and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) śuddha-vidyā 'pure knowledge' (karmadhāraya; śuddhā takes its masculine stem, Pāṇini 6.3.42). (2) …vidyā-aṅkura 'the sprouts of pure knowledge' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) …aṅkura-ākāra 'shaped like those sprouts' (bahuvrīhi of resemblance), qualifying dvija 'tooth' (karmadhāraya). (4) …dvija-paṅkti-dvaya 'the two rows of those teeth' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (5) ujjvalā 'resplendent' is the head and takes the two rows in the instrumental.

Analysis शुद्धा विद्या शुद्धविद्या; शुद्धविद्यायाः अङ्कुराः शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराः; शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराणाम् आकारः इव आकारः येषाम् ते शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकाराः; शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकाराः द्विजाः शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकारद्विजाः; तेषाम् पङ्क्त्योः द्वयम् शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकारद्विजपङ्क्तिद्वयम्; तेन उज्ज्वला शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकारद्विजपङ्क्तिद्वयोज्ज्वला
śuddhā vidyā śuddhavidyā; śuddhavidyāyāḥ aṅkurāḥ śuddhavidyāṅkurāḥ; śuddhavidyāṅkurāṇām ākāraḥ iva ākāraḥ yeṣām te śuddhavidyāṅkurākārāḥ; śuddhavidyāṅkurākārāḥ dvijāḥ śuddhavidyāṅkurākāradvijāḥ; teṣām paṅktyoḥ dvayam śuddhavidyāṅkurākāradvijapaṅktidvayam; tena ujjvalā śuddhavidyāṅkurākāradvijapaṅktidvayojjvalā

Significance Traditionally śuddhavidyā is taken here as the sixteen-syllabled Śrīvidyā mantra (ṣoḍaśī), the two rows of sixteen teeth answering to it; Her very smile shows the white, budding seeds of liberating knowledge.

Uncertain The identification of śuddhavidyā with the sixteen-syllabled mantra (and of the 32 teeth with it) is widely reported from the commentarial tradition; its exact source wording was not confirmed here.

26 कर्पूरवीटिकामोदसमाकर्षिदिगन्तरा karpūra-vīṭikāmoda-samākarṣi-dig-antarā

She whose fragrance of camphor-scented betel draws in all the quarters of space

Sandhi वीटिकामोद = वीटिका + आमोद (vīṭikā + āmoda) — savarṇa-dīrgha: ā + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); the second member is āmoda 'fragrance', not moda 'joy' — the fused ā hides the difference; दिगन्तरा = दिश् + अन्तरा (diś + antarā) — the final of diś becomes a velar at the end of a member (Pāṇini 8.2.62 kvinpratyayasya kuḥ), voiced to g by jaśtva (8.2.39): dig-

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, an upapada-tatpuruṣa and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) karpūra-vīṭikā 'a betel roll with camphor' (karmadhāraya with the middle word 'yukta, containing' dropped). (2) …vīṭikā-āmoda 'its fragrance' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) …āmoda-samākarṣin 'drawing in that fragrance' (upapada-tatpuruṣa; agent noun in -in from sam + ā + √kṛṣ, final n dropped). (4) dig-antara 'the reaches of the quarters' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa), qualified by (3). (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose quarters of space draw in the fragrance of Her camphor-betel', i.e. the fragrance pervades every direction.

Analysis कर्पूरयुक्ता वीटिका कर्पूरवीटिका; कर्पूरवीटिकायाः आमोदः कर्पूरवीटिकामोदः; कर्पूरवीटिकामोदम् समाकर्षन्ति इति कर्पूरवीटिकामोदसमाकर्षीणि; दिशाम् अन्तराणि दिगन्तराणि; कर्पूरवीटिकामोदसमाकर्षीणि दिगन्तराणि यस्याः सा कर्पूरवीटिकामोदसमाकर्षिदिगन्तरा
karpūrayuktā vīṭikā karpūravīṭikā; karpūravīṭikāyāḥ āmodaḥ karpūravīṭikāmodaḥ; karpūravīṭikāmodam samākarṣanti iti karpūravīṭikāmodasamākarṣīṇi; diśām antarāṇi digantarāṇi; karpūravīṭikāmodasamākarṣīṇi digantarāṇi yasyāḥ sā karpūravīṭikāmodasamākarṣidigantarā

Significance Traditionally read as the fragrance of Her betel pervading every direction and drawing beings from all quarters to Her. Betel with camphor is among the offerings (upacāra) of Her worship.

Uncertain The relation of samākarṣin to digantara admits two readings: the quarters draw in (are pervaded by) the fragrance, as analysed here, or the fragrance draws the beings of every quarter to Her, the usual paraphrase, which takes digantara by metonymy for those who dwell there.

Śloka 11names 27–28

निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सितकच्छपी ।
मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत्कामेशमानसा ॥ ११ ॥

nijasallāpamādhuryavinirbhartsitakacchapī |
mandasmitaprabhāpūramajjatkāmeśamānasā || 11 ||

The names, separated

27निज-सल्लाप-माधुर्य-विनिर्भर्त्सित-कच्छपीnija-sallāpa-mādhurya-vinirbhartsita-kacchapī

28मन्द-स्मित-प्रभा-पूर-मज्जत्-कामेश-मानसाmanda-smita-prabhā-pūra-majjat-kāmeśa-mānasā

Translation

27She who puts to shame even Sarasvatī's vīṇā, the Kacchapī, by the sweetness of Her own speech;

28She in the flood of whose gentle smile's radiance the mind of Kāmeśa is immersed.

Word by word

SanskritEnglish
27 निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सितकच्छपी nija-sallāpa-mādhurya-vinirbhartsita-kacchapī
निजnijaown
सल्लापsallāpaconversation, talksam + √lap 'to speak'; the same word as saṃlāpa
माधुर्यmādhuryasweetnessabstract noun from madhura 'sweet'
विनिर्भर्त्सितvinirbhartsitarebuked, put to shamevi + nir + √bharts 'to threaten, scold', past participle
कच्छपीkacchapīthe Kacchapī, the vīṇā of Sarasvatīnamed from kacchapa 'tortoise', after the tortoise-shaped body of the instrument
28 मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत्कामेशमानसा manda-smita-prabhā-pūra-majjat-kāmeśa-mānasā

Where the names meet

Name 27: kacchapī is the vīṇā of Sarasvatī, not a tortoise. Name 28: majjat 'sinking' is intransitive; Kāmeśa's mind sinks in the flood of Her smile.

The names

27 निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सितकच्छपी nija-sallāpa-mādhurya-vinirbhartsita-kacchapī

She who puts to shame even Sarasvatī's vīṇā, the Kacchapī, by the sweetness of Her own speech

Sandhi सल्लाप = सम् + लाप (sam + lāpa) — the m of the prefix sam becomes anusvāra and then the nasalised l homorganic with the following l (Pāṇini 8.3.23 mo 'nusvāraḥ; 8.4.58 anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ); the nasalised ll is ordinarily written plain ll

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa, a ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and a karmadhāraya). (1) nija-sallāpa 'Her own speech' (karmadhāraya). (2) …sallāpa-mādhurya 'the sweetness of that speech' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) The passive participle vinirbhartsitā 'rebuked, put to shame' takes the sweetness as its instrument (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa). (4) The whole is a bahuvrīhi in the instrumental relation: 'She by whom the Kacchapī has been put to shame by the sweetness of Her own speech'. The participle takes its masculine stem inside the bahuvrīhi (puṃvadbhāva); kacchapī is the last member and keeps its feminine ī.

Analysis निजः सल्लापः निजसल्लापः; निजसल्लापस्य माधुर्यम् निजसल्लापमाधुर्यम्; निजसल्लापमाधुर्येण विनिर्भर्त्सिता निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सिता; निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सिता कच्छपी यया सा निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सितकच्छपी
nijaḥ sallāpaḥ nijasallāpaḥ; nijasallāpasya mādhuryam nijasallāpamādhuryam; nijasallāpamādhuryeṇa vinirbhartsitā nijasallāpamādhuryavinirbhartsitā; nijasallāpamādhuryavinirbhartsitā kacchapī yayā sā nijasallāpamādhuryavinirbhartsitakacchapī

Significance In Saundaryalaharī 66 Sarasvatī, singing Śiva's deeds on her vīṇā, quietly wraps the instrument in its cover when the Goddess answers her, ashamed of its tone beside Her voice. Traditionally Her speech is the source of all speech, of which Sarasvatī's music is a part.

28 मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत्कामेशमानसा manda-smita-prabhā-pūra-majjat-kāmeśa-mānasā

She in the flood of whose gentle smile's radiance the mind of Kāmeśa is immersed

Sandhi कामेश = काम + ईश (kāma + īśa) — guṇa: a + ī → e (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ), inside the lexicalised name Kāmeśa

Compound bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, saptamī-tatpuruṣa and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (1) manda-smita 'a gentle smile' (karmadhāraya). (2) …smita-prabhā 'its radiance' and …prabhā-pūra 'the flood of that radiance' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (3) The present participle majjat 'sinking, being immersed' is intransitive and takes the flood in the locative (saptamī-tatpuruṣa): 'sinking in that flood'. (4) It qualifies kāmeśa-mānasa 'the mind of Kāmeśa' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa inside, karmadhāraya with the participle). (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She in the flood of whose gentle smile's radiance Kāmeśa's mind is immersed'; mānasa takes the feminine -ā. She does not plunge His mind; it sinks of itself.

Analysis मन्दम् स्मितम् मन्दस्मितम्; मन्दस्मितस्य प्रभा मन्दस्मितप्रभा; मन्दस्मितप्रभायाः पूरः मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरः; मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरे मज्जत् मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत्; कामेशस्य मानसम् कामेशमानसम्; मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत् कामेशमानसम् यस्याः सा मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत्कामेशमानसा
mandam smitam mandasmitam; mandasmitasya prabhā mandasmitaprabhā; mandasmitaprabhāyāḥ pūraḥ mandasmitaprabhāpūraḥ; mandasmitaprabhāpūre majjat mandasmitaprabhāpūramajjat; kāmeśasya mānasam kāmeśamānasam; mandasmitaprabhāpūramajjat kāmeśamānasam yasyāḥ sā mandasmitaprabhāpūramajjatkāmeśamānasā

Significance Traditionally even Kāmeśvara, Śiva who is ever self-possessed, is absorbed in Her smile; the smile is read as the bliss in which consciousness delights in itself.

कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रशोभितकन्धरा ॥ १२ ॥

anākalitasādṛśyacibukaśrīvirājitā |

The names, separated

29अन्-आकलित-सादृश्य-चिबुक-श्री-विराजिताan-ākalita-sādṛśya-cibuka-śrī-virājitā

30कामेश-बद्ध-माङ्गल्य-सूत्र-शोभित-कन्धराkāmeśa-baddha-māṅgalya-sūtra-śobhita-kandharā

Translation

29She who shines with the beauty of a chin for which no likeness can be conceived;

30She whose neck is adorned with the marriage thread tied by Kāmeśa.

SanskritEnglish
